title: Head of AI Engineering & Center of Excellence (CoE)
description: JOB DESCRIPTIONHead of AI Engineering& Center of Excellence (CoE)1. Role OverviewOur company is seeking a senior technology leader to establish and lead its AI Engineering Center of Excellence (CoE), driving the adoption of AI across enterprise engineering, insurance technology platforms, product development, and operational workflows.The Head of AI Engineering & CoE will define AI engineering strategy, establish reusable AI architectures and frameworks, enable AI-assisted software development, and deliver scalable, secure, measurable AI solutions. The role combines technical leadership, architecture governance, engineering enablement, and people development.A core objective is to turn individual AI experiments and isolated implementations into reusable enterprise capabilities that support Solartis’s product-platform strategy.1. Key ResponsibilitiesA. AI Engineering Strategy and CoE LeadershipEstablish the CoE charter, operating model, service offerings, engagement model, and delivery priorities.Develop an AI engineering roadmap aligned with product strategy, technology priorities, and business objectives.Identify opportunities to standardize AI capabilities and reduce duplicated implementations.Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, implementation guidelines, and approved technology frameworks.Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership to prioritize AI investments based on business value, feasibility, risk, and expected return.Establish processes to evaluate AI initiatives, productionize successful pilots, and retire ineffective or duplicated solutions.B. Enterprise AI Architecture and Shared FrameworksDefine scalable architectures for LLMs, SLMs, RAG, vector search, orchestration, and model integration.Design reusable AI services, APIs, SDKs, libraries, reference implementations, and deployment patterns.Establish patterns for model selection, prompt management, context engineering, embeddings, document processing, inference, and lifecycle management.Evaluate AI frameworks, models, infrastructure, and platforms for performance, cost, security, scalability, and maintainability.Define integration patterns for AI capabilities within existing platforms, services, applications, and development workflows.Guide build-versus-buy decisions across managed AI services, open-source models, and internally developed capabilities.C. AI-Assisted Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)Define and implement AI-assisted SDLC practices across requirements analysis, code generation, code understanding, test generation, code review, documentation, debugging, and maintenance.Establish standards for responsible use of AI coding assistants and developer productivity tools.Build reusable workflows and accelerators integrated with development environments, repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and quality processes.Measure impact on cycle time, defect rates, rework, code quality, and developer experience.Ensure AI adoption complements peer review, automated testing, security scanning, and release governance.Work with engineering leaders to drive adoption and develop team-level enablement plans.D. RAG, MCP, Agentic AI, and Reusable AI ServicesArchitect production-grade RAG solutions covering ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata extraction, indexing, retrieval, reranking, and grounded generation.Establish reusable patterns for agents, tool orchestration, workflow automation, context management, and human-in-the-loop processing.Define appropriate Model Context Protocol (MCP) patterns for controlled access to enterprise tools, data, and services.Develop common components for model access, prompt/context management, retrieval, tool integration, evaluation, telemetry, and error handling.Define safeguards for permissions, data access, execution boundaries, auditability, failure recovery, and human approval.Apply agentic AI selectively where it delivers measurable value and avoid unnecessary complexity in deterministic workflows.E. AI-Assisted Insurance Content Processing and Parser InitiativesLead architecture for processing insurance documents, policy forms, underwriting guidelines, rating manuals, and related content.Guide pipelines that transform semi-structured and unstructured content into validated, structured insurance product definitions.Establish reusable capabilities for classification, parsing, extraction, semantic interpretation, rule identification, and structured output generation.Ensure extracted content is traceable to source documents and suitable for downstream product configuration and processing.Design human review and exception handling for ambiguous, incomplete, conflicting, or low-confidence outputs.Define evaluation datasets and measures for extraction precision/recall, completeness, rule interpretation, and downstream usability.Promote reusable parsers and validation components over isolated customer-specific implementations, in collaboration with insurance domain and platform teams.F. AI Engineering Standards, Quality, and GovernanceDefine standards for AI design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance.Establish evaluation frameworks for accuracy, groundedness, robustness, reliability, latency, cost, and use-case suitability.Implement safeguards against prompt injection, unauthorized data exposure, insecure tool execution, and other AI-specific threats.Define model and prompt versioning, traceability, observability, regression evaluation, and controlled production releases.Establish practices for sensitive data handling, access control, retention, audit logging, and external AI services.Partner with security, compliance, legal, and enterprise architecture stakeholders on applicable requirements.Ensure solutions have appropriate fallbacks, exception handling, human oversight, and production-readiness reviews.G. Technical Leadership, Mentoring, and EnablementProvide technical leadership to AI architects and designated AI engineering teams, with accountability for architecture quality and capability development.Mentor existing architects in AI solution design, reusable architecture, model integration, evaluation, and production engineering.Establish architecture reviews, technical communities of practice, learning paths, workshops, and hands-on reference projects.Guide teams in evaluating alternatives, challenging assumptions, conducting impact analysis, and making sound technical decisions.Develop architecture decision records, implementation templates, reusable documentation, and engineering playbooks.Build internal capability so teams can implement AI solutions independently within agreed standards.H. Business Value, Delivery, and Continuous ImprovementTranslate opportunities into prioritized initiatives with defined outcomes, milestones, resource needs, and success measures.Partner with product, engineering, and business teams to improve developer productivity, reduce manual effort, accelerate content processing, and strengthen platform scalability.Maintain visibility into AI initiative status, adoption, risks, operating costs, and realized benefits.Track production outcomes beyond proof-of-concept delivery and optimize duplicated capabilities, infrastructure, and model costs.Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and measurable outcomes to the CTO and senior leadership.3. Leadership and Decision-Making ExpectationsEstablish and execute the AI engineering roadmap within priorities agreed with the CTO.Own the technical direction and engineering standards of the AI CoE.Lead and develop AI architects and designated AI engineering resources.Make decisions within agreed enterprise architecture principles and delegated authority; escalate material cross-platform, security, and investment decisions as required.Challenge designs that introduce unnecessary customization, duplication, operational complexity, or technical risk.Balance innovation with engineering discipline, production readiness, maintainability, and measurable business outcomes.Influence teams beyond the direct reporting line and enable adoption across the organization.4. Required Qualifications and ExperienceBachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related discipline.Typically 15+ years of relevant software engineering, architecture, or technology experience, including substantial practical experience with AI/ML and modern AI application architectures.Demonstrated experience leading AI engineering initiatives, architecture practices, technical teams, or enterprise AI programs.Strong practical knowledge of LLM applications, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and model evaluation.Experience designing production-grade AI services, APIs, orchestration workflows, and reusable frameworks.Practical understanding of agentic AI, tool integration, workflow orchestration, and MCP where relevant.Experience with Python, APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, automated testing, and cloud-based application deployment.Experience evaluating AI models and frameworks for quality, latency, cost, security, and operational complexity.Knowledge of AI application security, data protection, observability, model lifecycle management, and responsible AI practices.Demonstrated ability to mentor architects and engineers, influence technical direction, and establish standards across teams.Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions to executives, business stakeholders, and engineering teams.5. Preferred QualificationsExperience establishing an enterprise AI Engineering CoE or equivalent AI enablement function.Experience with comparable enterprise AI platforms and cloud-native AI services.Experience integrating AI-assisted software development tools into engineering workflows.Experience in insurance technology, policy administration, rating, product configuration, or document-intensive enterprise platforms.Experience with intelligent document processing, information extraction, rules extraction, or structured-content generation.Experience with enterprise knowledge systems, metadata-driven architectures, and reusable platform services.Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and production risk management.6. Leadership ProfileThe ideal candidate combines deep technical credibility with the ability to establish a sustainable engineering practice. They can move between architecture design, hands-on problem solving, technical mentoring, organizational enablement, and executive communication.The candidate should build systems and teams that scale, establish standards without unnecessary bureaucracy, and translate emerging AI technologies into practical business capabilities.Ultimate expectation: Establish an AI Engineering CoE that strengthens Solartis’s product-platform strategy, improves engineering effectiveness, accelerates AI adoption, and builds long-term organizational capability.

title: C++ Architect
description:
****Career Area:****
Engineering
  
  
****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Role Definition
  
  
Leads the design, development, testing, and architectural oversight of safety‑critical autonomy applications; collaborates with cross‑functional teams to meet internal and external needs.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Designing safety‑critical features end‑to‑end — translating requirements into technical designs for sensor data processing, object detection, threat assessment, and automated safety responses
* Guiding teams on real‑time embedded software design practices, ensuring components are modular, testable, and maintainable.
* Documenting architecture specifications, software design descriptions, verification plans, test cases, operating procedures, and safety procedures.
* Supporting developers in building and validating detection and decision‑making algorithms across multiple vehicle and machine configurations
* Utilizing appropriate tools to debug, test, and maintain software and hardware systems, leading verification and validation activities.
* Lead design and code reviews with focus on safety, correctness, numerical stability, and handling of degraded or missing data

Degree Requirement
  
  

* Requires a degree in Electronic/Electrical Engineering or Computer Science curriculum.
* More than 10 years of relevant industry experience in developing C++ applications

Skill Descriptors
  
  
Real‑Time Systems Integration
  
  
Knowledge of real‑time system architecture and multi‑system integration across sensing, compute, and actuation domains.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Designs and validates end‑to‑end data flows meeting real‑time latency and throughput requirements.
* Integrates software across CAN, Ethernet, and middleware in multi‑ECU architectures.
* Diagnoses timing, synchronization, and data‑consistency issues in distributed systems.
* Defines interface contracts including schemas, timing budgets, and failure modes.
* Evaluates system‑level trade‑offs between compute load, bandwidth, and safety margins.

Artificial Intelligence & Sensor Fusion
  
  
Knowledge of AI and sensor fusion concepts and methods, with awareness of applicable industry standards and safety expectations; ability to develop and apply perception and prediction algorithms for autonomous systems.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Designs and implements sensor fusion pipelines integrating radar, camera, and lidar data into a unified world model.
* Develops and tunes object detection, tracking, and prediction algorithms for real‑time autonomous decision‑making in safety‑critical contexts.
* Evaluates trade‑offs between algorithmic accuracy, latency, computational cost, and system‑level safety constraints on embedded platforms.
* Applies probabilistic and statistical techniques to noisy sensor data, accounting for uncertainty and failure modes.
* Supports validation of perception and prediction systems against ground truth, field data, and applicable standards or guidelines.
* Mentors others on integrating AI/ML components into safety‑critical software architectures.

Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
  
  
Knowledge of SDLC methodologies with ability to deliver, validate, and manage high‑quality software products.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Applies multiple vendor‑provided or in‑house SDLC methodologies with testing embedded across all phases.
* Converts requirements into robust, reviewable designs with explicit verification and testability considerations.
* Leads activities across all SDLC phases including design, implementation, integration, testing, validation, and release.
* Defines and executes test strategies, plans, and cases to validate functionality, error handling, reliability, and failure modes.
* Evaluates and consults on effective SDLC and testing practices using iterative and agile approaches.

Software Development
  
  
Knowledge of programming languages, tools, and Linux‑based development; ability to design, implement, debug, and maintain software for embedded and distributed systems.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Designs and develops software on Linux platforms, including embedded and system‑level components.
* Applies modern C++ (C++11/14/17), including concurrency, RAII, smart pointers, and memory‑safe patterns, in Linux environments.
* Uses Linux debugging and profiling tools to diagnose functional and performance issues.
* Oversees large development efforts aligned with system and architectural design.
* Evaluates programming trade‑offs across performance, memory, safety, and maintainability.
* Coaches junior engineers on programming best practices and Linux workflows.

Problem Solving & Technical Troubleshooting
  
  
Knowledge of structured problem‑solving methods and advanced troubleshooting techniques across organizational, hardware, software, and system domains; ability to resolve high‑impact issues.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Leads structured problem resolution and root‑cause analysis for complex, high‑impact issues.
* Analyzes complex technical problems and applies appropriate diagnostic techniques based on context and impact.
* Resolves critical or wide‑impact hardware, software, and communication failures.
* Drives urgency, prioritization, and decision‑making based on business impact.
* Directs cross‑team and multi‑vendor issue resolution and coach others on advanced troubleshooting techniques.

Additional Information
  
  
This position requires working onsite five days a week.
  
  
****Posting Dates:****
October 22, 2026 - November 29, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
  
  
Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

title: Senior APC Engineer – Process Optimisation Applications (AI/ML)
description:
For more than 140 years, Fuller Technologies has helped industrial producers solve complex process challenges and operate more efficiently, reliably, and sustainably. Our success is built on two foundations: engineering excellence and long-standing partnerships with our customers.
  
  
As a Senior APC Engineer, you will carry this legacy forward by applying advanced process control, analytics, and AI/ML technologies to cement and mining operations worldwide. At Fuller, APC engineering is not just about control algorithms — it is about understanding the process, earning customer trust, and delivering performance that lasts.
  
  
**About The Role**
You will be part of Fullers Process Optimisation Team, working with the ECS/ProcessExpert® APC toolbox and advanced control techniques such as MPC and AI/ML. Your role focuses on delivering APC and soft-sensor solutions that stabilise plant operations, improve throughput, and reduce energy and fuel consumption.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical role with responsibility across the full APC project lifecycle — from process analysis and model development to commissioning, optimisation, and long-term performance support.
  
  
'
  
  
**Your Responsibilities :**

* Perform process and data analysis using historical and real-time data from cement and minerals plants to identify optimisation opportunities.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy predictive models and soft sensors using linear and non-linear AI/ML algorithms.
* Implement, validate, and maintain real-time APC applications using MPC, AI/ML, fuzzy logic, and PID control strategies.
* Estimate and quantify process improvement benefits using data analytics, supporting performance guarantees and technical proposals.
* Adapt, tune, and retrain models and controllers to ensure sustained performance and operational stability.
* Define and implement process control strategies, including configuration and commissioning of APC solutions.
* Fine-tune MPC, fuzzy, and PID controllers to achieve guaranteed performance targets related to productivity, energy efficiency, and stability.
* Support system integration activities, including hardware selection, software installation, and connectivity with PLCs, DCS, and historians.
* Collaborate with project managers and customer teams to ensure APC projects are delivered on schedule and to specification.
* Provide training and technical mentoring to APC engineers on data analytics and AI/ML applications within the ECS/ProcessExpert® platform.
* Evaluate emerging developments in advanced analytics and non-linear modelling to continuously improve APC applications.
* Contribute across the broader APC lifecycle, including sales support, product development, feature testing, and service support as required.

**''**
**What You Bring**

* Strong hands-on experience in Advanced Process Control, Data Analytics, Machine Learning, and AI applied to industrial processes.
* Proven experience in data mining, statistical modelling, model deployment, and real-time implementation.
* Background in process manufacturing industries; cement and minerals process knowledge is a strong advantage.
* Solid understanding of process optimisation, control strategy development, and benefit analysis.
* Experience with industrial data connectivity and historians, including SQL, MQTT, PLCs, DCS, and modern data platforms.
* Proficiency with AI/ML and data analytics tools commonly used in process industries, including:
* Python, Pandas, NumPy
* Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow
* Matplotlib, Seaborn
* Databricks

Willingness to travel (10–25%) within India and internationally for commissioning, pilot testing, customer engagement, and training.
  
  
*As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger*
**Application and contact**
Please apply by clicking “apply” on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews - also on a virtual setting as required - on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible.
  
  
No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please.
  
  
**Build a better world**
Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. It is a big responsibility, and we are committed to driving growth while minimising environmental impact. To achieve this, your skills, your curiosity, and your drive for change are important. Together in our diverse team, we collaborate in an inclusive and supportive environment to discover further ways to economic and environmental success.
  
  
For further information on Fuller Technologies' business and services, visit https://www.fuller-technologies.com/

title: Senior Projects Manager – Computational Biology/Bio-Computing & AI
description:
**Job Title: Senior Projects Manager – Computational Biology & AI**

**Experience:**
PhD with 5–10 years post-PhD substantial hands-on experience in computational biology/bioinformatics, AI/ML, with demonstrated leadership of handling complex technical projects. Must have proficiency in Python/ relevant scientific computing & AI frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and associated data science libraries. Should be experienced with large-scale data processing, distributed computing, cloud-computing, GPU-based model training, or high-performance computing, DevOps & MLOps.

**Education: Ph.D**
. in Bioinformatics/Computational Biology/Computer Science with Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, or a related quantitative discipline with strong understanding of machine learning, deep learning models, & modern AI architectures.

**Role Type:**
Full-time | Research, Technology Product Development & AI Innovation

**Position Overview:**

We are seeking a highly accomplished and visionary
**Senior Projects Manager – Computational Biology & AI**
to lead the research, development, and deployment of innovative computational algorithms, large-scale machine learning models, and advanced artificial intelligence systems for multi-omics biological data.

The role will focus on building next-generation AI capabilities that integrate, analyze, and interpret complex, heterogeneous, and high-dimensional biological datasets, especially on
**multi-omics datasets and other molecular and clinical data modalities**
.

The successful candidate will lead multidisciplinary teams in developing scalable AI/ML architectures, multimodal foundation models, predictive algorithms, and automated interpretation engines that transform complex biological data into clinically and scientifically meaningful insights. This position combines
**scientific innovation, AI/ML research leadership, computational platform development, and project/program management**
, requiring the ability to translate complex scientific challenges into robust, scalable, and impactful AI-driven solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI/ML Algorithm Development and Innovation**

* Lead the design and development of innovative computational algorithms and advanced machine learning models for biological data analysis, interpretation, and prediction.
* Develop novel approaches for extracting meaningful biological signals from complex, noisy, sparse, high-dimensional, and heterogeneous datasets.
* Drive research and implementation of deep learning, transformer-based architectures, graph neural networks, generative AI, self-supervised learning, contrastive learning, and other advanced AI methodologies.
* Establish methodologies for model training, predictive modelling, model optimization, validation, benchmarking, explanability and continuous improvement.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and translate promising research into scalable computational solutions.

**2. Multi-Omics Integration & Multimodal AI**

* Lead the development of algorithms and AI models capable of integrating and interpreting diverse biological data types.
* Design advanced computational frameworks for cross-modal data integration, representation learning, feature extraction, and biological knowledge discovery.
* Develop unified or interoperable AI models that learn from multiple data modalities and generate integrated biological and clinical interpretations.
* Address challenges associated with missing modalities, batch effects, technical variability, data sparsity, population heterogeneity, and differences across platforms and experimental technologies.
* Explore the development of multimodal biological foundation models capable of learning generalizable representations across datasets, diseases, populations, and use cases.

**3. Large-Scale Machine Learning and AI Model Development**

* Architect, develop, and manage large-scale AI/ML models trained on extensive and diverse biological, molecular, clinical, and biomedical datasets.
* Lead the development of domain-specific foundation models, including models for biological sequence understanding, molecular representation learning, disease signatures, & integrated multi-omics interpretation.
* Build scalable data-processing and model-training pipelines to support large datasets, distributed computing, GPU-based workloads, and high-throughput analytical workflows; and optimize computational efficiency, inference performance, reproducibility, scalability, and deployment readiness..
* Develop reusable model architectures, training frameworks, feature libraries, and computational components that can be applied across multiple scientific and clinical applications.
* Establish strategies for pretraining, fine-tuning, transfer learning, domain adaptation, & continual model improvement.

**4. Automated Biological and Clinical Data Interpretation**

* Lead development of automated interpretation engines that convert raw or processed biological data into structured, actionable, and scientifically grounded insights.
* Build AI-driven workflows that integrate data quality assessment, feature extraction, model inference, evidence aggregation, interpretation, & report generation.
* Develop computational approaches for identifying disease-associated molecular patterns, clinically relevant biomarkers, molecular subtypes, & potential mechanisms of disease to enable automated interpretation across multiple use case.
* Incorporate biological knowledge bases, pathway databases, literature-derived evidence, and other curated knowledge resources to improve interpretability & contextual relevance.

**5. Computational Biology Research and Scientific Leadership**

* Define the computational biology & AI research roadmap in alignment with organizational scientific, product, and business objectives; and translate emerging scientific discoveries & computational methodologies into practical AI capabilities.
* Identify high-impact novel research opportunities at the intersection of systems biology, multi-omics, machine learning, & precision medicine and lead development of novel methodologies, algorithms, prototypes, & proof-of-concept systems.
* Critically evaluate scientific literature, benchmark emerging methods, and establish best practices for computational research; incorporate methodological innovation, reproducible research, & publication-quality analytical standards.
* Collaborate with domain experts to ensure that developed models capture meaningful biological relationships rather than relying solely on statistical associations.

**6. Project and Program Management**

* Own end-to-end execution of complex AI and computational biology projects, from problem definition and feasibility assessment through research, development, validation, and deployment.
* Develop project plans, milestones, resource requirements, timelines, budgets, and measurable success criteria, and manage multiple concurrent projects and prioritize initiatives based on scientific value, technical feasibility, strategic importance, and business impact.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams comprising computational biologists, bioinformaticians, laboratory scientists, clinicians, and product teams.
* Establish effective project governance, risk management, technical reviews, and performance reporting processes. Anticipate scientific, data, computational, regulatory, operational risks, and develop mitigation strategies.
* Ensure timely delivery of robust, scalable, well-documented, and maintainable AI solutions.

**7. Data Engineering, DevOps, MLOps, and Platform Development**

* Guide the design of scalable data architectures and computational pipelines for the ingestion, harmonization, transformation, and analysis of multi-omics & clinical datasets.
* Oversee the development of robust workflows for data preprocessing, quality control, normalization, feature engineering, and metadata management.
* Establish model development, deployment practices covering experiment tracking, version control, automated testing, model registries, monitoring, & reproducibility.
* Operationalize research models within production-grade computational platforms, APIs, analytical applications, and automated reporting systems, and promote cloud-native and distributed computing architectures where appropriate.
* Ensure appropriate data security, access controls, privacy protections, and governance throughout the data and model lifecycle.

**8. Model Validation, Explainability, and Responsible AI**

* Establish rigorous validation frameworks to assess model accuracy, robustness, generalizability, reproducibility, and clinical or scientific utility.
* Design appropriate benchmarking strategies, independent test sets, external validation studies, & prospective evaluation approaches where feasible, and evaluate model performance.
* Develop interpretable AI methods that help scientists & clinicians understand model predictions and their supporting evidence.
* Implement uncertainty quantification, out-of-distribution detection, bias assessment, & safeguards against unsupported interpretations.
* Work with clinical, quality, regulatory, and compliance teams to align development and validation practices with applicable requirements, particularly for intended clinical use.

**9. Team Leadership and Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams across computational biology, AI/ML research, bioinformatics, and data science and establish a culture of innovation, scientific integrity, technical excellence, collaboration, & accountability.
* Communicate scientific findings, technical strategies, project status, and business implications to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Translate broad scientific and clinical requirements into clearly defined computational problems, development roadmaps, and measurable deliverables.
* Build cross-functional alignment among research, clinical, product, and commercial teams, and manage collaborations with all external stakeholders, where required.

The incumbent solves problems by determining the best architecture, within departmental guidelines, from many existing solutions.

* Four-year bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in a Computer Science or Information Technology, or related field
* 12+ years or more of software development experience or at least 3 years of architecture experience with strong demonstrable experience.

* Strong understanding of AI concepts and latest developments (Gen AI, MCP, ATA, etc.).

title: Software Dev Engineer II, Profit Intelligence
description:
**Description**
Are you interested in building intelligence systems from the ground up?
  
  
Are you interested in working with Applied Scientists, Big Data Engineers and Software Development Engineers to build large-scale data intelligence systems?
  
  
Are you interested to work in a team that positively impacts different key pillars of Amazon like Pricing, Promotions, Advertising, Auto inventory purchasing, Auto inventory removal, Inventory placement?
  
  
Are you interested in working for a team that builds cool systems yet has great work-life balance?
  
  
Profit intelligence systems measures, predicts true profit(/loss) for each item as a result of a specific shipment to an Amazon customer.
  
  
Prot Intelligence is all about providing intelligent ways for Amazon to understand profitability across retail business. What are the hidden factors driving the growth or profitability across millions of shipments each day?
  
  
Profit Intelligence provides these answers.
  
  
We compute the profitability of each and every shipment that gets shipped out of Amazon. Guess what, we predict the profitability of future possible shipments too. We are a team of agile, can-do engineers, who believe that not only are moon shots possible but that they can be done before lunch. All it takes is finding new ideas that challenge our preconceived notions of how things should be done. Process and procedure matter less than ideas and the practical work of getting stuff done. This is a place for exploring the new and taking risks.
  
  
We push the envelope in using cloud services in AWS as well as the latest in distributed systems, forecasting algorithms, and data mining.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to design and build AI-powered data platforms that transform large-scale business data into actionable insights. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, distributed systems, and data engineering — owning end-to-end development of tools that help business leaders make faster, better decisions.
  
  
This is a high-impact role on a team where the software you ship directly shapes financial and operational strategy across Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Architect and build scalable platforms that ingest, process, and serve insights from petabyte-scale datasets
  
  
Integrate large language models and generative AI capabilities into internal analytics tools — enabling natural language querying, anomaly explanation, and automated reporting
  
  
Design ML pipelines for anomaly detection, forecasting, and trend analysis over structured and semi-structured business data
  
  
Partner with scientists, analysts, and PMs to translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped technical solutions
  
  
Drive engineering excellence: define coding standards, lead design reviews, and set the bar for operational health (monitoring, oncall, runbooks)
  
  
Mentor junior engineers; raise the technical capability of the team through clear documentation and code review
  
  
Own your services in production — you build it, you run it
  
  
Build and operate our foundational data infrastructure comprising of the entire spectrum of AWS Services - Storage (Redshift Data Shares, s3 data lakes), Orchestration (Step Functions, Glue and Internal Java Based Orchestration Tools), Processing (Spark & Flink - KDA), Streaming services (AWS Kinesis) and real-time large scale event aggregation stores.
  
  
Making it fully configurable and self-service for non-engineers.
  
  
Build and evolve tools that empower Amazonians to access data and build reliable, scalable and configurable way to generate Unit Economics for all Amazon Businesses. This includes UIs and frameworks for configuring rules, simulating their application, approval workows for rule changes, APIs and caching layers for high-throughput serving of Unit Economics Historicals and Predictions.
  
  
Build systems that secure and govern our data end to end: control access across multiple storage and access layers (like inhouse Reporting Applications and BI tools), track data quality, catalogue datasets and their lineage, detect duplication, audit usage and ensure correct data semantics.
  
  
You will be responsible for designing and building platforms for crunching 100s of TB of in-coming data from dozens of sources and financial events around the company.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 30% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 30% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

The Industry PhD — FPGA & Embedded Vision Systems role at Kelvin6k is a full-time, on-site position based in Chennai. The role involves designing, implementing, and optimizing FPGA-based architectures and embedded vision algorithms for robotic and 3D printing systems. Daily responsibilities include developing and testing hardware–software interfaces, integrating sensors and vision modules, and collaborating with robotics and mechanical teams to improve system performance and reliability. * Practical knowledge of computer vision algorithms, image processing, and real-time implementation on embedded platforms.
* Experience working with robotics or automation systems, preferably in industrial or construction environments.

title: AI Engineer
description:
**About Moative**

Moative is an AI diffusion company. We partner with midmarket companies in asset-heavy, regulated industries to co-build deeply industry-specific agentic and machine learning solutions, which then get diffused across the industry through revenue-share and equity-linked models.

Our Past: We have built and sold two companies, one of which was an AI company. Our founders and leaders are Math PhDs, Ivy League University Alumni, Ex-Googlers, and successful entrepreneurs.

Team: Our team of 20+ employees consists of data scientists, AI/ML Engineers, and mathematicians from top engineering and research institutes such as IITs, CERN, IISc, UZH. Our team includes academicians, IBM Research Fellows, and former founders.

This role focuses on healthcare and RCM, working alongside our AI/ML engineers, data scientists and domain specialists.

**Work you’ll do**

We are looking for an experienced AI engineer with hands-on experience in healthcare and revenue cycle management (RCM). You will build and deploy AI agents, automations and data workflows for healthcare operations, with a focus on the US market. The work includes payer-portal automation for claim status and EOB retrieval, voice agents for payer follow-up, analysis of claim journeys and bottlenecks, and AI-assisted insights into practice performance. You will work directly with billing and operations teams, owning delivery from understanding the workflow through deployment, evaluation and ongoing improvement.

**Responsibilities**

● Own AI agent and automation workflows from requirements through design, development, deployment and monitoring.

● Build agents that work across payer portals, healthcare documents, practice-management systems, EHR-connected tools and voice channels.

● Turn fragmented healthcare data into validated, structured inputs for automation and analysis.

● Work directly with billing and operations teams to understand workflows, resolve exceptions and improve systems based on user feedback.

● Evaluate workflow accuracy and completion rates using representative test sets. Monitor failures and operating costs, and implement retries, exception queues and human escalation.

● Implement approved privacy and security controls for sensitive healthcare data, including access restrictions, audit trails and safeguards against exposing patient information in logs or model inputs.

● Diagnose and improve failures across data ingestion, integrations, agent execution and user-facing workflows.

● Measure operational outcomes, such as time saved, reduced manual effort and faster turnaround, with the teams using the systems. Who you are You are a passionate and results-oriented engineer who is driven by the potential of AI/ML to revolutionize processes, enhance products, and ultimately improve user experiences. You thrive in dynamic environments and are comfortable navigating ambiguity. You possess a strong sense of ownership and are eager to take initiative, advocating for your technical decisions while remaining open to feedback and collaboration. You are adept at working with real-world, often imperfect data, and have a proven ability to develop, refine, and deploy AI/ML models into production in a cost-effective and scalable manner. You are excited by the prospect of making US healthcare operations faster and more reliable, for the people who run them and the patients they serve. Skills & Requirements Must have

● At least 2 years of professional AI engineering experience, including deploying and supporting systems used in real operations. Internships and academic projects alone do not meet this requirement.

● Hands-on experience building AI or automation solutions for healthcare RCM workflows, such as claim status checks, accounts receivable follow-up, denial management, payment posting or payer interactions.

● Practical understanding of how billing teams work, how claims move through the revenue cycle, and how incomplete data and exceptions affect execution.

● Experience deploying and supporting an LLM-based application or AI agent in production, using capabilities such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling or multi-step workflows. Ability to explain your engineering contribution, how the system was evaluated, what failed and how you addressed it.

● Strong production Python and SQL skills, experience integrating APIs, and working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript for browser automation or application integration.

● Experience automating workflows across APIs, browsers or user interfaces, using tools such as Playwright, Selenium or UiPath, with error handling and human escalation where needed.

● Experience deploying and monitoring applications on at least one cloud platform—AWS, Azure or GCP—using containers, version control and automated testing.

● Experience handling imperfect inputs such as scanned PDFs, inconsistent portal layouts or incomplete records, with validation and exception handling.

● Experience working directly with billing or operations teams, improving systems based on their feedback, and demonstrating outcomes such as time saved, claims processed or reduced turnaround time.

● Experience handling sensitive healthcare data through appropriate access controls, secure logging and approved data-handling practices.

**Preferred experience**

● Experience delivering solutions for US healthcare providers, RCM companies or payer-facing operations, including working with US billing teams and payer workflows.

● Experience with practice-management or EHR integrations, payer portals, explanation of benefits (EOB) documents or electronic remittance advice (ERA) data.

● Experience analyzing claim histories, revenue-cycle bottlenecks or practice performance.

● Experience building voice agents or integrating speech-to-text and text-to-speech services is a plus.

● Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations.

● Experience with Kubernetes, serverless applications or event-driven architectures. Working at Moative Moative is a young company, but we believe strongly in thinking long-term, while acting with urgency. Our ethos is rooted in innovation, efficiency and high-quality outcomes. We believe the future of work is AI-augmented and boundaryless.

**Here are some of our guiding principles:**

● Think in decades. Act in hours. As an independent company, our moat is time. While our decisions are for the long-term horizon, our execution will be fast – measured in hours and days, not weeks and months.

● Own the canvas. Throw yourself in to build, fix or improve – anything that isn’t done right, irrespective of who did it. Be selfish about improving across the organization – because once the rot sets in, we waste years in surgery and recovery.

● Use data or don’t use data. Use data where you ought to but not as a ‘cover-my-back’ political tool. Be capable of making decisions with partial or limited data. Get better at intuition and pattern-matching. Whichever way you go, be mostly right about it.

● Avoid work about work. Process creeps on purpose, unless we constantly question it. We are deliberate about committing to rituals that take time away from the actual work. We truly believe that a meeting that could be an email, should be an email and you don’t need a person with the highest title to say that out loud.

● High revenue per person. We work backwards from this metric. Our default is to automate instead of hiring. We multi-skill our people to own more outcomes than hiring someone who has less to do. We don’t like squatting and hoarding that comes in the form of hiring for growth. High revenue per person comes from high quality work from everyone. We demand it.

If this role and our work is of interest to you, please apply. When applying, describe one or two healthcare or RCM systems you have delivered, including your contribution, production challenges and outcomes. Share only material you are authorized to disclose; anonymized descriptions are sufficient. That said, you should demonstrate that you are in the 90th percentile or above.

The position is based out of Chennai. Our work currently involves significant in-person collaboration and we expect you to work out of our offices in Chennai.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
About Moative

Moative is an AI diffusion company. We partner with midmarket companies in asset-heavy, regulated industries to co-build deeply industry-specific agentic and machine learning solutions, which then get diffused across the industry through revenue-share and equity-linked models.

**Our Past**

: We have built and sold two companies, one of which was an AI company. Our founders and leaders are Math PhDs, Ivy League University Alumni, Ex-Googlers, and successful entrepreneurs.

**Team**

: Our team of 20+ employees consists of data scientists, AI/ML Engineers, and mathematicians from top engineering and research institutes such as IITs, CERN, IISc, UZH. Our team includes academicians, IBM Research Fellows, and former founders. This role leads technology for our healthcare business, working alongside forward-deployed engineers, data scientists and revenue cycle operators to build an AI management services organization (AI MSO) for US healthcare practices.

Work you’ll do

We are building an AI management services organization (AI MSO) for US healthcare practices. We combine operational expertise, data infrastructure and AI to manage and improve revenue cycle and administrative workflows. We automate suitable tasks progressively, with clear controls and human accountability for exceptions and consequential decisions.

As CTO, you will own the technology strategy, platform architecture and engineering organization behind this business. You will work with our founders, practice owners and billing leaders to decide what to build, which workflows to prioritize and how to measure results. You will remain hands-on in architecture, prototypes, code reviews and difficult production problems.

You will build a reusable platform that connects practice systems, supports reliable automation and captures operational learning across engagements, while maintaining appropriate separation of each practice’s data. The work includes payer-portal agents, voice-based payer follow-up, claim-journey analysis, denial management and payment-posting workflows.

Technical leads will own day-to-day pod delivery within the direction you set. You will resolve major technical trade-offs, develop those leaders and remain accountable for platform quality, reliability and technical risk.

Responsibilities

* Own technology strategy, platform architecture and engineering standards for the healthcare AI MSO.
* Work with founders, practice owners and billing leaders to assess workflows, establish baselines and prioritize investments by business value, feasibility and dependencies.
* Lead product and platform decisions, balancing practice-specific requirements with capabilities that can be reused across customers and specialties.
* Design solutions across EHRs, practice-management systems, clearinghouses and payer portals, connecting data pipelines, AI agents and operator workflows.
* Define the practice data architecture, integrating claims, remittances, EOBs, denial codes and operational records into validated, traceable data with clear access controls and isolation between practices.
* Separate operational data that requires patient identifiers from de-identified analytical datasets, and define approved uses of each.
* Stay hands-on through architecture and code reviews, targeted prototypes and resolution of complex production issues.
* Make build-versus-buy, vendor and model decisions based on reliability, security, cost and business value.
* Establish technical controls for healthcare privacy, security and compliance, working with legal, compliance and client stakeholders on approved data flows, retention, vendor access and incident response.
* Set production evaluation and release criteria, including monitoring, human escalation, recovery procedures and ownership of failures.
* Own engineering and infrastructure budgets, platform operating costs and investment in reusable capabilities.
* Hire, develop and retain engineers, data scientists and technical leads, with clear accountability for quality and delivery.
* Represent Moative’s technology with practice owners, partners and investors, explaining technical choices and their implications for practice economics.

Who you are

You are a technology leader who has built products and remains close to engineering. You can decide what to build with a practice owner, examine an architecture with an engineer and explain investment choices to an executive or investor.

You have worked with fragmented operational systems, inconsistent data and workflows that depend on people’s judgment. You investigate how work is actually done before deciding what to automate, and you understand that reliable data and clear processes are foundations for useful AI.

You have built and scaled products or a technology business, made decisions with incomplete information and stayed accountable for customer adoption and commercial outcomes. You can develop strong technical leaders while stepping into difficult engineering problems when needed.

You want to build the technology foundation of an AI MSO and take responsibility for how it performs as the business grows.

Skills & Requirements

Must have

* At least 15 years of relevant engineering and technology leadership experience, with recent hands-on involvement in architecture, solution design, prototyping and production troubleshooting.
* Experience building and scaling a product or technology business in a founding, CTO or senior engineering leadership role, with clear evidence of customer adoption, commercial outcomes and your own contribution.
* Experience owning product and technology decisions from customer discovery through production, adoption and ongoing improvement.
* Deep experience integrating, cleaning and modeling fragmented operational data, including building reusable platforms serving multiple customers with clear data isolation and access boundaries.
* Experience leading teams that deploy and support AI in live operations, including LLM-based applications or agents, with evaluation, monitoring and human escalation.
* Strong Python, SQL and cloud architecture skills across at least one platform—AWS, Azure or GCP—with the ability to review code, challenge designs and build prototypes.
* Experience delivering healthcare or RCM products, with practical understanding of billing workflows, claim submission, payer interactions, denials, appeals and payment posting.
* Experience establishing technical controls for sensitive healthcare data, including access management, audit trails, secure logging, vendor access and incident response.
* Experience building engineering and data teams, hiring senior technical leaders and establishing engineering standards.
* Experience owning technology budgets, vendor decisions and operating costs, and explaining investment trade-offs in business terms.
* Experience working directly with CXOs, founders and investors to agree priorities, resolve conflicting expectations and communicate technical risk.
* Ability to demonstrate a product you chose to build, the architecture and team you developed, the trade-offs you made and the results achieved.

Preferred experience

* Experience building for US outpatient practices, MSOs or RCM companies, including working with US billing teams and payer workflows.
* Experience taking a company through an acquisition, merger or other successful exit, including technical diligence and transition responsibilities.
* Experience turning services engagements or client-specific solutions into reusable products and platforms.
* Experience with healthcare data exchange and integrations involving claims, remittances, EHRs, practice-management systems or clearinghouses.
* Experience with process mining, operational knowledge systems or adapting smaller models for domain-specific tasks.
* Experience building browser automation or voice agents for operational workflows.

**Location: Chennai or Bangalore.**

Chennai preferred. This role involves regular in-person collaboration with our founders and the healthcare AI pod.

Working at Moative

Moative is a young company, but we believe strongly in thinking long-term, while acting with urgency. Our ethos is rooted in innovation, efficiency and high-quality outcomes. We believe the future of work is AI-augmented and boundaryless. Here are some of our guiding principles:

* **Think in decades. Act in hours.**

  As an independent company, our moat is time. While our decisions are for the long-term horizon, our execution will be fast – measured in hours and days, not weeks and months.
* **Own the canvas.**

  Throw yourself in to build, fix or improve – anything that isn’t done right, irrespective of who did it. Be selfish about improving across the organization – because once the rot sets in, we waste years in surgery and recovery.
* **Use data or don’t use data.**

  Use data where you ought to but not as a ‘cover-my-back’ political tool. Be capable of making decisions with partial or limited data. Get better at intuition and pattern-matching. Whichever way you go, be mostly right about it.
* **Avoid work about work**

  . Process creeps on purpose, unless we constantly question it. We are deliberate about committing to rituals that take time away from the actual work. We truly believe that a meeting that could be an email, should be an email and you don’t need a person with the highest title to say that out loud.
* **High revenue per person.**

  We work backwards from this metric. Our default is to automate instead of hiring. We multi-skill our people to own more outcomes than hiring someone who has less to do. We don’t like squatting and hoarding that comes in the form of hiring for growth. High revenue per person comes from high quality work from everyone. We demand it.

We’d love to hear about a product you helped build and scale, ideally in healthcare or another regulated, data-intensive industry—covering the customer problem, key decisions, team, challenges, results, and your role. Founding or exit experience is welcome. Please share only authorized information; anonymized examples work well.

title: Manager - Navigation & Control
description:
**About Planys Technologies**

Planys Technologies is a next-gen defence technology startup building intelligent autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) and maritime robotic systems that give naval and security forces a real-time, machine-driven picture of the undersea battlespace. Inspired by the pace, ambition, and product mindset of modern defence innovators, we are designing persistent, ROVs, AUVs, and hybrid surface vessel edge-compute heavy payloads, and advanced undersea sensing that turn oceans into knowledgeable, navigable, and defendable environments.

Engineers and researchers work like full-stack product teams: shaping hydrodynamics and propulsion, architecting navigation and perception stacks, and building autonomy and mission-systems software that must perform in GPS-denied, low-comms, high-risk conditions. You will see your code and hardware leave the lab quickly, iterate through real sea trials, and plug into high-impact naval, coastal security, and strategic deterrence missions in India and beyond. You’ll be part of a small, high-caliber team empowered to move fast, take end-to-end ownership, and push the boundaries of what underwater systems can sense, decide, and achieve in one of the most demanding environments on Earth.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a Manager – Navigation & Control to design, develop, integrate, and validate navigation and control systems for autonomous underwater vehicles.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement navigation algorithms (INS, DVL, USBL aiding, EKF/UKF sensor fusion) for AUV platforms operating in GPS-denied environments.
* Develop and tune guidance and control systems, including autopilots, path-following (LOS, Pure Pursuit), station-keeping, and depth/heading controllers.
* Build high-fidelity simulation environments for algorithm validation, including Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing.
* Integrate and calibrate navigation sensors, including IMU, DVL, USBL, pressure sensors, and magnetometers, on vehicle hardware.
* Implement real-time GNC software on embedded Linux platforms with deterministic timing requirements.
* Develop harbour-to-harbour navigation, mission planning, and waypoint management modules, and integrate them with the vehicle autonomy stack.
* Analyse and resolve navigation and control anomalies using sea-trial data, and drive post-trial reviews.
* Define and execute verification and validation (V&V) plans for GNC subsystems against system-level requirements.
* Support system-level integration, sea trials, and field deployments, and troubleshoot vehicle behaviour on-site.
* Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, and software teams on vehicle-level design trade-offs and interface definitions.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including algorithm design documents, test reports, and calibration procedures.
* Create and track team work plans, mentor junior engineers, and provide technical guidance.

**Required Skills**

* Strong mathematical and analytical background.
* Strong knowledge of navigation, estimation, sensor fusion, and control systems.
* Proficiency in C/C++ and Python.
* Experience with ROS/ROS2, Linux, Git, and simulation tools.
* Knowledge of INS, DVL, USBL, EKF/UKF, PID, LQR/MPC.
* Experience with robotic or autonomous systems.
* Strong problem-solving and teamwork skills.

**Qualification**

* M.Tech / M.S. / Ph.D. in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Ocean Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Robotics, or related fields.
* 4–8 years of relevant experience in navigation, guidance, and control for robotic/autonomous systems.
* Experience in marine or underwater robotics is preferred.
* Research/thesis experience in navigation, control, or state estimation is an added advantage.

title: Software Quality Engineer – Automation & AI
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Film and Scatterometry Technology (FaST) division delivers industry-leading metrology solutions essential to advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its portfolio includes systems for measuring film thickness, critical dimensions, composition, and resistivity—key to developing and scaling next-gen IC processes. FaST partners closely with customers from early R&D through high-volume production, ensuring performance and process alignment.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Qualify new and existing software products and features through functional, regression, performance, reliability, and system-level testing.
* Design, develop, and execute test plans, test cases, and validation strategies to ensure high product quality.
* Analyze test results and publish qualification reports, recommendations, training materials, and Best Known Methods (BKMs).
* Collaborate with Algorithm, System Engineering, Applications Engineering, Product Management, Manufacturing, Marketing, and Customer Support teams across global locations.
* Assess automation feasibility and develop automated test solutions, frameworks, and tools to improve test coverage and efficiency.
* Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design reviews, deployment, troubleshooting, and customer support.

**AI & Innovation Responsibilities**

* Leverage Generative AI and AI-powered tools to improve test design, execution, defect analysis, reporting, and documentation.
* Develop AI-enabled utilities, applications, and productivity tools for engineering and quality workflows.
* Explore and implement solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and modern AI frameworks.
* Drive AI adoption within the SQE organization by identifying, prototyping, and deploying high-impact use cases.
* Utilize AI and data analytics techniques to improve quality insights, root cause analysis, and engineering productivity.

**Desired Skills**

* Strong programming skills in Python, C#, C++, or Java.
* Experience with software testing, automation frameworks, and quality engineering methodologies.
* Exposure to AI/ML concepts, Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, AI agents, or AI application development is preferred.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Additional Requirements**

* Represent SQE in product lifecycle reviews, key program meetings, and cross-functional initiatives.
* Willingness to travel to customer fabrication facilities for use-case understanding, software deployment, and troubleshooting support as required.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

5. Agentic AI & Intelligent Automation

* Define standards for agent observability, evaluation, access control, governance, and operational reliability.
* Ensure that autonomous workflows operate within clearly defined business rules, permissions, and accountability boundaries.

6. AI Platform Engineering & Production Delivery

* Own the architecture, engineering, deployment, and scaling of enterprise AI platforms in production environments.
* Establish engineering practices for MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps, including CI/CD, model lifecycle management, testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Drive the development of production-ready AI applications using robust APIs, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native platforms.
* Establish end-to-end AI evaluation frameworks covering quality, accuracy, reliability, security, latency, scalability, and cost.
* Ensure AI solutions meet enterprise requirements for availability, resilience, performance, maintainability, and operational support.
* Maintain strong technical oversight of critical architecture decisions, engineering standards, and production implementations.

7. AI-Powered Engineering Transformation

* Lead enterprise-wide adoption of AI-assisted software development and intelligent engineering workflows.
* Drive AI-enabled code generation, code review, automated testing, documentation, developer assistance, and DevOps automation.
* Partner with engineering leadership to identify productivity bottlenecks and establish measurable improvements in software delivery.
* Develop frameworks to assess AI-assisted engineering quality, developer productivity, defect reduction, and delivery efficiency.

* Establish enterprise AI governance frameworks covering responsible AI, privacy, security, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
* Define policies for model access, data protection, prompt injection mitigation, sensitive information handling, and AI application security.
* Ensure appropriate human oversight, auditability, explainability, and traceability for AI-assisted and agent-driven decisions.
* Partner with Security, Legal, Compliance, and Architecture teams to establish risk-based controls for enterprise AI adoption.
* Implement governance mechanisms for model evaluation, production approval, change management, incident response, and continuous monitoring.

9. Technology Innovation & Strategic Partnerships

* Lead AI innovation programs, technology incubation, proofs of concept, and enterprise-scale pilots.

* Establish strategic technology partnerships and guide build-versus-buy decisions.
* Convert promising AI experiments into scalable production capabilities with clear adoption and business-value criteria.

10. Portfolio, Budget & Business Outcome Management

* Own the AI division's delivery portfolio, investment priorities, resource utilization, and operational performance.
* Establish governance for AI project prioritization, delivery milestones, dependencies, and risk management.
* Define measurable business cases for AI initiatives and track their impact on productivity, operating costs, quality, customer experience, and revenue opportunities.
* Communicate portfolio performance, investment requirements, delivery risks, and realized business value to executive stakeholders.

  in software engineering, technology architecture, enterprise platforms, and technology leadership.
* Significant experience leading large engineering, architecture, AI/ML, or platform engineering organizations.

Mandatory Technical Expertise

AerX Space Labs

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu

3–6 Months

Engineering students, final-year students and recent graduates
