Full-time / Project-based

About AerX Space Labs

AerX Space Labs is focused on developing next-generation intelligent robotic and autonomous systems, including aerial drones, quadruped robotic dogs, autonomous ground robots and underwater robotic platforms.

We are looking for
**highly motivated, technically capable and hands-on robotics interns**
who can quickly contribute to the design, development, assembly, programming and testing of real-world robotic systems.

This opportunity is intended for students who have already built robotics projects and are passionate about transforming engineering concepts into functional prototypes.

Key Responsibilities
  
1. Robotics Design & Mechanical Development

* Design robotic structures, chassis, joints, mounting systems and mechanical assemblies.
* Develop 3D CAD models using SolidWorks, Fusion 360, CATIA or equivalent tools.
* Support mechanical design for quadruped robots, autonomous ground vehicles and robotic mechanisms.
* Select motors, actuators, gearboxes, bearings and mechanical components.
* Support 3D printing, fabrication, prototype assembly and mechanical testing.

2. Electronics & Embedded Systems

* Select and integrate microcontrollers, sensors, motor drivers and communication modules.
* Work with Arduino, ESP32, STM32, Raspberry Pi or NVIDIA Jetson platforms.
* Integrate servo motors, BLDC motors, encoders, IMUs, LiDAR and cameras.
* Assist with power distribution, battery management and electronic troubleshooting.
* Develop and test embedded control systems.

3. Robotics Programming & Autonomous Navigation

* Develop robotic control software using Python and C/C++.
* Work with ROS/ROS 2 for robotic communication, control and navigation.
* Implement motion control, locomotion, obstacle avoidance and path planning.
* Support SLAM, sensor fusion and autonomous navigation.
* Integrate real-time sensor data with robotic control systems.

4. AI & Computer Vision Integration

* Integrate cameras and AI vision systems into robotic platforms.
* Support object detection, human detection, obstacle recognition and intelligent surveillance applications.
* Work with OpenCV, PyTorch, TensorFlow or YOLO-based detection systems.
* Assist with deploying AI models on edge computing devices.
* Support integration with Mirador AI for intelligent perimeter surveillance and automated alerts.

5. Prototype Assembly & Testing

* Assemble complete robotic prototypes from mechanical and electronic components.
* Perform hardware and software integration.
* Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical and programming issues.
* Conduct controlled indoor and outdoor testing.
* Document engineering designs, test results, component specifications and improvements.

Required Qualifications

Students pursuing or recently completing:

* B.E./B.Tech – Robotics & Automation
* Mechatronics Engineering
* Mechanical Engineering
* Electronics & Communication Engineering
* Electrical & Electronics Engineering
* Computer Science / Artificial Intelligence

Students from other disciplines with demonstrated robotics project experience are also welcome.

Essential Skills

Candidates should have practical experience in
**at least two**
of the following areas:

* Mechanical design and CAD modelling
* Robotics hardware assembly and fabrication
* Embedded systems and motor control
* Python, C/C++ or ROS 2
* Sensors, actuators and electronic integration
* Autonomous navigation or computer vision

Preferred Experience

Preference will be given to candidates who have:

* Built a working robotic prototype independently or as part of a team.
* Participated in robotics competitions, hackathons or university robotics clubs.
* Developed quadruped robots, robotic arms, mobile robots, drones or autonomous vehicles.
* Worked with 3D printing, electronics prototyping and hardware debugging.
* Published robotics projects on GitHub or maintained technical project portfolios.

**Previous commercial work experience is not mandatory. Demonstrated practical capability is more important than academic grades alone.**

What We Expect

We are specifically looking for interns who are:

* **Hands-on builders**
  , not just theoretical learners.
* Capable of understanding an engineering requirement and quickly developing a functional prototype.
* Comfortable assembling, programming, testing and troubleshooting hardware.
* Able to work independently while collaborating with mechanical, electronics and AI teams.
* Interested in contributing directly to real product development.
* Disciplined about engineering documentation, safe testing and meeting project milestones.

Selection Process

**Stage 1 – Project Portfolio Review**

Candidates must submit photographs, videos, GitHub repositories or technical descriptions of robotics projects they have personally developed.

**Stage 2 – Technical Interview**

Assessment of mechanical design, electronics, embedded systems, robotics programming and troubleshooting skills.

**Stage 3 – Practical Engineering Assessment**

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a small, time-bound robotics design or programming task using accessible tools and equipment.

**Stage 4 – Final Selection**

Selection based on technical capability, practical experience, problem-solving skills and readiness to contribute to active projects.

Internship Benefits

* Work on real-world robotics and autonomous systems.
* Hands-on exposure to mechanical design, electronics, AI and robotic software development.
* Opportunity to contribute to the development of AerX robotic products.
* Technical mentoring and collaborative engineering experience.
* Internship completion certificate based on successful participation.
* Potential consideration for full-time engineering opportunities based on performance and business requirements.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit:

1. Updated resume.
2. Details of robotics projects completed.
3. Photographs or videos demonstrating working prototypes.
4. GitHub, CAD portfolio or other relevant technical work.
5. Availability and preferred internship duration.

**Email:**
hr@miradortechnologies.ai

**Subject:**
Application – Robotics Design & Development Internship – AerX Space Labs

**AerX Space Labs**

*Design. Build. Program. Innovate.*

**We are looking for students who don't just study robotics — they build robots.**

title: Junior APC Engineer - Process Optimisation Application (PXP)
description:
Join a Culture That Moves Fast — and Brings You With It.
  
  
At Fuller Technologies, momentum isn’t a slogan — it’s how we work. For over 140 years, we’ve improved the systems that keep the cement industry running: optimizing processes, reducing friction, and elevating performance. That mindset shapes not only our solutions — but how we operate as a company.
  
  
When you join Fuller, you’re joining a team that supports your growth and values your contribution. Here, colleagues collaborate openly, leaders give you room to develop, and the environment is built on trust, inclusion, and continuous learning. You’ll find the stability of a global organization and the agility of one that’s actively expanding — a place where your career can accelerate alongside the business.
  
  
If you want to move forward with a company that brings its people with it — Fuller is where that happens.
  
  
**About The Role**
For more than 140 years, Fuller Technologies has helped industrial producers solve complex process challenges and operate more efficiently, reliably, and sustainably. Our success is built on two foundations:
  
  
engineering excellence and long-standing partnerships with our customers.
  
  
As a Junior APC Engineer, you will carry this legacy forward by applying advanced process control, analytics, and AI/ML technologies to cement and mining operations worldwide. At Fuller, APC engineering is not just about control algorithms — it is about understanding the process, earning customer trust, and delivering performance that lasts.
  
  
You will be part of Fullers Process Optimisation Team, working with the ECS/ProcessExpert® APC toolbox and advanced control techniques such as MPC and AI/ML. Your role focuses on delivering APC and soft-sensor solutions that stabilise plant operations, improve throughput, and reduce energy and fuel consumption. This is a hands-on technical role with responsibility across the full APC project lifecycle — from processanalysis and model development to commissioning, optimisation, and long-term performance support.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities:**

* Perform process and data analysis using historical and real-time data from cement and minerals plants to identify optimisation opportunities.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy predictive models and soft sensors using linear and nonlinear AI/ML algorithms. Implement, validate, and maintain real-time APC applications using MPC, AI/ML, fuzzy logic, and PID control strategies.
* Estimate and quantify process improvement benefits using data analytics, supporting performance guarantees and technical proposals.
* Adapt, tune, and retrain models and controllers to ensure sustained performance and operational stability. Define and implement process control strategies, including configuration and commissioning of APC solutions.
* Fine-tune MPC, fuzzy, and PID controllers to achieve guaranteed performance targets related to productivity, energy efficiency, and stability.
* Support system integration activities, including hardware selection, software installation, and connectivity with PLCs, DCS, and historians.
* Collaborate with project managers and customer teams to ensure APC projects are delivered on schedule and to specification.
* Provide training and technical mentoring to customer engineers on data analytics and AI/ML applications within the ECS/ProcessExpert® platform.
* Evaluate emerging developments in advanced analytics and non-linear modelling to continuously improve APC applications.
* Contribute across the broader APC lifecycle, including sales support, product development, feature testing, and service support as required.

**You bring**

* Strong hands-on experience in Advanced Process Control, Data Analytics, Machine Learning, and AI applied to industrial processes.
* Proven experience in data mining, statistical modelling, model deployment, and real-time implementation.
* Background in process manufacturing industries; cement and minerals process knowledge is a strong advantage.
* Solid understanding of process optimisation, control strategy development, and benefit analysis.
* Experience with industrial data connectivity and historians, including SQL, MQTT, PLCs, DCS, and modern data platforms.
* Familiarity with AI/ML and data analytics tools commonly used in process industries, including: Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, TensorFlow, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Databricks
* Willingness to travel (50–70%) within India and internationally for commissioning, pilot testing, customer engagement, and training.

*As an equal opportunity employer, Fuller Technologies embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply irrespective of sex, gender identity/expression, disability, sexual orientation, or age. The more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.*
**Application and contact**
Please apply by clicking “apply” on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews - also on a virtual setting as required - on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible.
  
  
No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please.
  
  
**Build a better world**
Fuller Technologies helps build societies all over the world by contributing to the infrastructure needed for global economic growth. It is a big responsibility, and we are committed to driving growth while minimising environmental impact. To achieve this, your skills, your curiosity, and your drive for change are important. Together in our diverse team, we collaborate in an inclusive and supportive environment to discover further ways to economic and environmental success.

**Education\***

* Graduation / Post Graduation

+ Not Mandatory

title: Specialist - Corporate Audit
description:
**Company Profile**
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)**
Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Objective**
The Data Analytics Specialist will support the Corporate Audit function by developing and executing data analytics solutions to enable risk-based audits, SOX compliance, fraud detection, continuous auditing, and ERM initiatives. The role will focus on
**leveraging analytics-related tools**
(e.g., IDEA, Alteryx, Azure) and
**SAP data**
to deliver actionable insights and scalable audit analytics.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Audit Data Analytics & Automation**

* Design, develop, and maintain models and/or workflows for audit analytics, fraud detection, SOX testing, and continuous auditing.
* Document the processes and procedures for models or workflows developed.
* Build, document, and maintain an inventory of audit analytics and use cases across business processes (e.g., P2P, O2C, Inventory, GL, etc.).
* Automate repetitive audit testing procedures to improve audit coverage and efficiency (e.g., test populations versus samples).
* Perform risk-based data analysis, including exception testing, trend analysis, and anomaly detection.

**Risk Monitoring, Fraud & ERM Support**

* Support fraud desk initiatives through advanced analytics and red flag identification using structured SAP data.
* Enable risk response monitoring aligned with ERM and Internal Audit priorities.
* Develop analytics to support management’s proactive risk identification and control effectiveness assessment.

**Technology & Data Enablement**

* Work directly with SAP source data (e.g., FI, MM, SD, Inventory modules) and ensure accurate data extraction and transformation.
* Leverage Azure or similar data platforms for large-scale risk analysis and enterprise analytics.
* Address data sourcing limitations and improve data reliability for audit consumption.
* Act as a subject-matter expert for analytics tools (e.g., IDEA and Alteryx), including workflow optimization and complexity review.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with Internal Audit, Compliance, IT, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to understand risk areas and data availability.
* Provide clear visibility on analytics deliverables, scope, and outcomes to audit leadership.
* Support follow-up discussions with stakeholders on analytics-driven observations.

**Governance & Capability Building**

* Define standards and governance for audit analytics development and documentation.
* Review and validate complex models and workflows developed by the team to ensure quality and sustainability.
* Support training and mentoring of auditors on the use and interpretation of analytics.

**Qualifications**

* Requires a bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5 - 7 Years of relevant experience in Data Analytics using Alteryx.

title: Specialist - Data Engineering
description:
**Role Description**
Location- Chennai, Bangalore
  
  
Experience - 5 to 8years
  
  
Shift- 2:30 pm to 12 am Hybrid
  
  
SAS Developer SAS to Snowflake Migration
  
  
**Job Description Data Analytics**
Role Snapshot
  
  
Role TitleSAS Lead Developer SAS Migration Specialist
  
  
FunctionData Analytics Data Modernisation
  
  
Experience 5 to 8 years with at 5 years handson in SAS
  
  
EngagementFulltime
  
  
Reports to Principal Architecture Data Analytics
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an experienced SAS developer to join a legacy modernisation programme that is moving an established SAS estate onto Snowflake The person in this role will be the teams authority on what the existing SAS code actually does reading Base SAS and SAS macro programs tracing the data lineage behind them and translating that logic into Snowflake and modern ELT pipelines without changing business outcomes
  
  
This is a handson engineering role rather than a support role Expect to spend most of your time in code in reconciliation and in conversation with the business users who rely on the reports and datasets being migrated The work is well suited to someone who has lived inside a large SAS codebase and now wants to carry that knowledge into a cloud data platform
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Analyse and document the existing SAS estate Base SAS programs macros PROC SQL DATA steps scheduled jobs and stored processes and produce the code inventory complexity rating and dependency map that drive the migration wave plan
  
  
Convert SAS logic into equivalent Snowflake stored procedures and ELT pipelines preserving business rules joins aggregations formats and edgecase handling rather than reimplementing from assumption
  
  
Own data reconciliation between the SAS output and the Snowflake output build rowcount controltotal and recordlevel comparison scripts investigate breaks and sign off each migrated object against agreed tolerance
  
  
Reengineer SAS data access layers that read from files RDBMS sources and SAS datasets so they land in Snowflake through the programmes chosen ingestion pattern
  
  
Work with the architecture team on target data models translating SASera structures into curated Snowflake schemas that suit setbased processing
  
  
Tune migrated workloads for cost and performance warehouse sizing clustering pruning and query rewrites so that converted jobs meet or beat their existing batch windows
  
  
Engage report owners and business analysts to confirm interpretation of legacy logic retire redundant code instead of migrating it and support user acceptance testing through to cutover
  
  
Maintain migration artefacts mapping documents conversion standards test evidence and runbooks and mentor junior engineers on reading SAS code safely
  
  
MustHave Skills
  
  
Strong handson Base SAS SAS Macro PROC SQL and DATA step development including formats informats arrays hash objects and bygroup processing
  
  
Proven ability to read and reverseengineer undocumented longlived SAS programs and explain what they do in business terms
  
  
Advanced SQL with practical exposure to Snowflake virtual warehouses stages streams tasks time travel cloning and micropartition behaviour
  
  
Experience on at least one completed legacytocloud data migration with responsibility for validation and reconciliation not only code conversion
  
  
Working knowledge of Python or a comparable scripting language for conversion accelerators automated comparison and repetitive refactoring
  
  
Comfortable with version control structured testing and defect tracking in a deliverymanaged environment

title: Senior AI & Cloud Security Architect
description:
**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.**
At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
  
  
Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Genesys Global Security, Privacy & Compliance Centre of Excellence (COE SPC) provides expert security advisory services to Sales, Pre-Sales, Customers, and Partners. The team serves as the single point of contact for all security, privacy, and compliance-related customer engagements within the Genesys Cloud Business Unit.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Senior
**AI Cloud Security Architect**
to join the Genesys Global Security, Privacy & Compliance Centre of Excellence (COE SPC) as a technical Security Subject Matter Expert (SME). This is a hands-on, customer-facing technical security role, not a compliance or GRC position. You will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Product Security, and Architecture teams to support consulting, customer audits, security assessments, technical reviews, executive briefings, and evidence-based engagements for Genesys Cloud.
  
  
As one of the team's technical security SMEs, you will apply your expertise in cloud security, AI security, and security controls to explain and defend the Genesys Cloud security, privacy, and compliance posture. You will interpret technical evidence, respond to complex security inquiries, defend security contractual terms, and engage directly with customers, partners, auditors, and executive stakeholders within the APAC region.
  
  
This role is highly consultative and requires excellent English communication and presentation skills. You will regularly represent Genesys Cloud during customer executive briefings, security workshops, webinars, conferences, partner events, and industry forums. You must be comfortable presenting complex technical security concepts to audiences ranging from security practitioners and architects to CISOs, CIOs, and other senior executives, both remotely and in person, to any of our global customers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead customer-facing security discussions with customers, prospects, partners, auditors, and internal stakeholders on Genesys Cloud architecture, penetration testing, vulnerability management, remediation, privacy, compliance, and AI security.
* Provide technical consulting that maps Genesys Cloud security capabilities and controls to customer security, regulatory, and risk management requirements.
* Develop, validate, and present technical evidence demonstrating the effectiveness of controls across identity and access management, encryption, key management, network security, logging, monitoring, incident response, application security, AI security, and secure software development.
* Deliver technical deep dives, security workshops, and executive briefings for audiences ranging from security practitioners and auditors to CISOs, CIOs, and senior business leaders.
* Own complex customer security, privacy, and compliance matters and contractual security negotiations.
* Represent Genesys at strategic customer engagements, partner events, conferences, webinars, and industry forums across APAC, contributing to external security thought leadership.

**This Role Offers**

* A highly technical, customer-facing Cloud Security Architect role within a global Centre of Excellence.
* Collaboration with Engineering, Product Security, Architecture, Privacy, Compliance, and AI teams.
* Exposure to complex enterprise cloud environments and leading global customer security organisations.
* The opportunity to shape customer trust in Genesys Cloud and its AI capabilities through technical assurance, executive engagement, and industry representation.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 7+ experience cybersecurity, cloud security, application security, security architecture, or related technical security disciplines.
* Strong practical expertise in AWS security, cloud-native architectures, APIs, Kubernetes, and modern SaaS security models.
* Proven experience designing, securing, operating, or assessing enterprise cloud environments and cloud-native applications.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, Agentic AI, conversational AI, or other AI-enabled application architectures, including their security and data-protection risks.
* Practical knowledge of modern AI security threats and controls, including prompt injection, data leakage, insecure output handling, excessive agency, model and tool abuse, identity and authorization risks, and AI supply-chain dependencies.
* Experience applying recognized AI security guidance, including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and OWASP Agentic AI security guidance.
* Strong understanding of identity and access management, encryption, data protection, API security, vulnerability management, threat modelling, and DevSecOps practices.
* Working understanding of privacy and compliance considerations associated with enterprise AI, particularly data handling, access, retention, transparency, governance, and third-party AI services.
* Experience supporting enterprise security assessments, technical due diligence, audits, customer assurance, or customer-facing security engagements.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical security and AI concepts clearly to both highly technical teams and senior executives.

**Nice-to-Have Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience designing, deploying, securing, integrating, or operating enterprise virtual agents/assistants (AVAs), conversational AI, AI agents, or similar AI-powered customer experience solutions.
* Experience taking AI-enabled applications into production, including API/tool integrations, identity and authorization, data flows, guardrails, observability, monitoring, and operational security.
* Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, threat modelling, AI security assessments, or model/application evaluation frameworks.
* Experience assessing AI systems against emerging AI governance, privacy, security, or regulatory requirements.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code, security automation, CI/CD security, or cloud security engineering.
* Experience working with enterprise contact-centre, conversational AI, customer experience, or communications platforms.
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty, CISSP, CCSP, GIAC, or comparable security certifications.
* Understanding of ISO/IEC 42001 and AI management system principles.

**Working at Genesys**

* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
* Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
* Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
* Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.
  
  
**What Happens After You Apply**
After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:
  
  

* Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team
* A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview.
* Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team
* We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases
* After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.
  
  
**Stay Connected**
Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available.
  
  
Get notified about relevant opportunities.
  
  
**Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together.**

**About Genesys:**
Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. title: AI Quality Engineer, Safety and RAG - Assistant Vice President
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced AI Quality Engineer to join our Retail and Wealth Risk Engineering team under the Enterprise Risk Technology platform. This role spans the full spectrum of modern AI quality engineering — from
**Agentic AI flow testing**
and
**RAG pipeline validation**
to
**AI safety, test automation**
, and
**performance & reliability engineering**
.
  
  
You will be the quality pillar for complex autonomous AI systems, ensuring they are
**safe, accurate, explainable, resilient, and production-ready**
at scale. This is a high-impact, highly technical role that requires both depth in AI/ML and breadth across testing disciplines.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Agentic AI Testing
  
  

* Design and execute end-to-end test strategies for Agentic AI pipelines, including single-agent and multi-agent workflows.
* Validate agent reasoning, planning, and decision-making chains (e.g., ReAct, Chain-of-Thought, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion).
* Test tool-use correctness — ensuring agents invoke the right tools, with correct parameters, at the right time.
* Evaluate agent memory systems (short-term, long-term, episodic) for accuracy and context retention across sessions.
* Validate agent handoff and delegation logic in multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., AutoGen, CrewAI, LangGraph).
* Test termination conditions, loop detection, and infinite loop prevention in autonomous agent loops.

RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) Testing
  
  

* Design comprehensive test strategies for end-to-end RAG pipelines — covering ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, reranking, and generation stages.
* Validate retrieval accuracy and relevance — ensuring the correct context chunks are retrieved for a given query.
* Test embedding model quality and vector similarity thresholds across different document corpora.
* Evaluate faithfulness, groundedness, and answer relevance of generated responses using frameworks like RAGAS, TruLens, DeepEval.
* Test chunking strategies (fixed, semantic, hierarchical) for their impact on retrieval quality.
* Validate context window management — ensuring retrieved context does not exceed token limits or degrade generation quality.
* Conduct end-to-end regression testing when the underlying knowledge base, embedding model, or LLM changes.
* Test multi-turn conversational RAG for context coherence and citation accuracy across turns.

Test Automation
  
  

* Build and maintain automated test harnesses for Agentic and RAG systems, including agent trajectory replay, tool mock injection, and prompt simulation.
* Develop automated evaluation pipelines integrated into CI/CD workflows for continuous model and agent validation.
* Create data validation and data quality frameworks (using Great Expectations, Deequ, or custom tooling) for training, retrieval, and inference data.
* Build prompt regression suites to detect behavioral drift across LLM versions or prompt changes.
* Implement determinism and reproducibility tests for stochastic LLM-based decisions.
* Automate vector database validation — index integrity, embedding drift, and retrieval consistency checks.

**AI Safety & Security Testing**

* Conduct red-teaming and adversarial testing to uncover jailbreaks, prompt injection vulnerabilities, and goal misalignment in LLM-based systems.
* Test output guardrails and content filters for unsafe, biased, toxic, or out-of-scope model behavior.
* Validate privilege escalation controls — ensuring agents do not exceed permitted actions or access unauthorized resources.
* Perform data poisoning and backdoor attack simulations to assess model robustness.
* Evaluate models for bias, fairness, and discrimination using frameworks such as AI Fairness 360 and Aequitas.
* Test PII leakage and data privacy controls in RAG and agent pipelines in accordance with GDPR, CCPA, and internal data governance policies.
* Conduct security testing aligned with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, including:

+ Prompt Injection (Direct & Indirect)
+ Insecure Output Handling
+ Training Data Poisoning
+ Insecure Plugin / Tool Design
+ Sensitive Information Disclosure

* Validate constitutional AI constraints, RLHF-aligned behavior boundaries, and system prompt integrity.
* Collaborate with cybersecurity teams on AI-specific threat modeling and vulnerability management.
* Maintain safety testing playbooks and document red-team findings with severity ratings and remediation recommendations.

Performance & Reliability Testing
  
  

* Define and execute load, stress, soak, and spike testing for AI-powered APIs, inference endpoints, and agent orchestration services.
* Measure and optimize end-to-end latency across RAG and agentic pipelines — from query to final response.
* Benchmark LLM inference throughput (tokens/second) and identify bottlenecks across model serving infrastructure.
* Test auto-scaling behavior of AI services under variable load conditions.
* Validate circuit breaker, retry, and fallback mechanisms in agentic and RAG systems for graceful degradation.
* Test vector database performance — query latency, index build time, and retrieval accuracy under high concurrency.
* Conduct cost efficiency analysis — measuring token consumption, API call costs, and infrastructure spend per agent task.
* Establish SLOs (Service Level Objectives) and SLAs for AI system availability, latency percentiles (P50, P95, P99), and error rates.
* Collaborate with MLOps teams to set up observability dashboards, monitoring alerts, and automated anomaly detection for production AI systems.
* Perform chaos engineering experiments to validate agent and RAG system resilience under infrastructure failures.

Domain Knowledge
  
  

* Deep understanding of RAG architecture patterns — naive RAG, advanced RAG, modular RAG.
* Solid grasp of agent design patterns: ReAct, Plan-and-Execute, Reflexion, MRKL, Mixture-of-Agents.
* Familiarity with AI safety and alignment principles (RLHF, Constitutional AI, guardrail layers).
* Knowledge of token economics, context management, and LLM cost optimization.
* Proficiency in performance engineering methodologies for distributed AI systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agentic communication standards.
* Exposure to multi-modal agent testing (agents handling text, images, code, documents).
* Experience in regulated industries (banking, finance, healthcare) with strict compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with chaos engineering tools (Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, LitmusChaos).

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Master’s degree is a plus.

**Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in software or AI/ML quality engineering.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with RAG systems, or Agentic AI.
* Proven experience building automated test frameworks for non-deterministic AI systems.
* Strong background in performance testing and AI safety/security assessments.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Ciklum**
is looking for a
**Senior Engineering Manager**
to join our team full-time in India.
  
  
We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Senior Engineering Manager, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. Senior Engineering Manager to lead a greenfield build of our agentic AI systems — autonomous, multi-step workflows where AI agents plan, use tools, and act with minimal human intervention. You'll own technical direction, team growth, and delivery for a group of 10–15 engineers working at the intersection of LLMs, orchestration, and production infrastructure, building this platform from the ground up.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and grow a team of AI & Forward Deployed Engineers building agent orchestration, tool-use frameworks, and evaluation pipelines from zero
* Set technical strategy for agent architecture: planning loops, memory, tool calling, multi-agent coordination, and guardrails
* Drive the implementation of an AIDLC (AI-Driven Development Lifecycle) approach, replacing traditional PDLC/SDLC practices across the org
* Own the Observability and Evals strategy for agentic systems — tracing, monitoring, and eval frameworks for non-deterministic, multi-step workflows
* Partner with product managers to translate ambiguous problems into shippable agentic features
* Own reliability and safety practices for autonomous systems (evals, sandboxing, human-in-the- loop checkpoints, rollback strategies)
* Drive hiring, mentorship, and career growth for your team
* Balance hands-on technical involvement (architecture reviews, code reviews) with people management
* Report on team velocity, system performance, and risk to leadership
* Sketch out engineering estimations

**Requirements**

* 12+ years in software engineering, with 5+ years managing engineering teams
* Direct experience building or operating LLM-powered systems (agents, RAG, tool-calling, orchestration frameworks like LangGraph, AutoGen, or custom stacks)
* Proven track record of delivering an AIDLC implementation that successfully replaced PDLC/SDLC within an engineering organisation
* Cloud: AWS — excellent knowledge with Bedrock AgentCore, Step Functions (ASL), and related agent-hosting/orchestration services
* Strong knowledge of Harness engineering
* Strong experience with Observability and Evals for non-deterministic systems (tracing, eval harnesses, monitoring, drift/regression detection)
* Backend services: experience with Python and FastAPI
* Frontend: working knowledge of React, Tailwind, and Solstice (JLL design system)
* Track record of shipping ambiguous, fast-moving products under real constraints
* Excellent communicator who can translate technical tradeoffs for non-technical stakeholders

**What’s in it for you?**

* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

**About Us**
At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
  
  
India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.
  
  
**Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!**
Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

title: Specialist, Technology - Software
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The LS-SWIFT division delivers high-throughput patterned wafer inspection systems that support advanced semiconductor manufacturing. Its mission is to provide industry-leading defect detection with optimal cost of ownership across a wide range of applications. LS systems enable precise, cost-effective inspection for cutting-edge process nodes, while SWIFT systems offer comprehensive macro inspection of all wafer surfaces—capabilities that are especially critical for advanced packaging, as well as logic, memory, and automotive applications.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Strong software architecture expertise designing complex, distributed, scalable, high-performance, and data-intensive systems.
* Experience across legacy and modern technology stacks, with the ability to evolve existing platforms and drive architectural improvements.
* Deep technical knowledge in one or more areas: enterprise architecture, cloud-native services, microservices, AI/ML infrastructure, big data platforms, or DevOps automation.
* Proven ability to design and deliver medium-to-large scale software systems in multi-developer, cross-functional environments.
* Strong systems thinking and analytical skills, capable of simplifying ambiguity, evaluating trade-offs, and solving complex technical challenges.
* Expertise in scalability, performance optimization, reliability, and future-proof software design, ensuring robust architectures, code quality, and maintainability.
* Ability to translate complex business and technical requirements into architecture, detailed designs, and executable engineering plans.
* Strong technical leadership and mentoring skills, influencing architects, senior engineers, and technical leads across organizations, geographies, and disciplines.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, effectively engaging both technical and non-technical stakeholders in global teams.
* Ownership-driven mindset with a focus on execution, innovation, and engineering excellence, leveraging modern development practices and AI-assisted engineering tools.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience building and architecting complex distributed systems.
* Familiarity with UI/UX design considerations in engineering applications.

**Technical Skills:**

* Programming: C#, C++, Java, Python, .NET
* Architectural Paradigms: Microservices, service-oriented architecture, modular monolith, layered architecture, event-driven architecture
* Legacy Modernization: Monolith decomposition, migration from thick-client/desktop stacks to modern service-based platforms, backend/frontend separationWorking knowledge of container technologies, orchestration frameworks (e.g., Kubernetes), and workflow automation.Strong grasp of software development best practices, CI/CD, and DevOps principles.
* Leadership & Communication: Demonstrated ability to lead and drive functional teams. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Passion for mentoring and developing engineering talent.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 6 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 8 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. *We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Frontier Foundation Lead
description:
**Leading at Cognizant**
This is a Leadership role at Cognizant. We believe how you lead is as important as what you deliver. Cognizant leaders at every level:
**Drive our business strategy**
and inspire teams around our future.
**Live the leadership behaviors**
, leading themselves, others and the business.
**Uphold our Values**
, role modeling them in every action and decision.
**Nurture our people and culture**
, creating a workplace where all can thrive.
  
  
At Cognizant, leadership transcends titles and is embodied in actions and behaviors. We empower our leaders at every level to drive business strategy, inspire teams, uphold our values, and foster an inclusive culture.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Frontier Foundation Lead, you will make an impact by building the reusable intellectual capital of the Frontier Capability Unit (FCU) - the offerings, methodologies, accelerators, tools and assets that give SEG's AI-native engagement model its edge - and taking that capital to market and into client delivery. You will be a valued member of the Frontier Capability Unit team and work collaboratively with SEG Solutioning, GSA, the IDU and Frontier Talent community, hyperscaler and model partners, industry analysts, and clients.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own the offering and accelerator roadmap across Agentic Coding & ADLC, Autonomous Agents & Runtime and Vertical Solutions, including domain and hyperscaler-specific offerings, and sponsor the Garage / R&D build of new assets and proof points ahead of client demand.
* Build and maintain delivery kits, composable tooling (MCP & Skills), delivery methodology and pod-design patterns consumed by the IDU and the Frontier Talent community, owning their availability and quality.
* Own the asset / IP register for the unit and the Enterprise Runtime & Governance standard that assets must meet before they are published for re-use.
* Supply estimation models, productivity guidance and Assurance & Evaluation proof points into new and vendor-consolidation deals, and co-create bid support with SEG Solutioning / GSA.
* Own hyperscaler, model-partner (Anthropic, Google / Gemini, OpenAI) and Agentic Trust & Security ecosystem relationships and represent the FCU's capability to industry analysts.
* Consistently demonstrate the Cognizant Way to Lead, which means operating with Personal Leadership (building trust, collaboration, and inclusion), Organizational Leadership (driving vision and purpose, demonstrating a strategic and enterprise mindset, and creating and communicating a bold direction that inspires purpose), and Business Leadership (exemplifying client focus, managing ambiguity with accountability and results, and operating with financial acumen)

**What You Need To Have To Be Considered**

* 20+ years in IT services, with 10+ years in AI-native / GenAI engineering, solutioning or offering & IP leadership.
* Strong technical / solutioning grounding in AI-native and GenAI engineering, credible enough to set an offering roadmap and engage architects and partners.
* A proven track record of taking IP to market through pre-sales support, accelerator build, and analyst / partner engagement.
* Experience building estimation and proof-point models for bids.
* A builder-evangelist profile with market-facing scope, able to lead a direct and indirect span of 20-30 across pillar-aligned focus areas.
* Embodiment of the Cognizant Way to Lead: Leading Self, Leading Others, & Leading the Business
* The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The right Thing, & Own It

**These will help you succeed**

* Working knowledge of major model and cloud ecosystems — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google / Gemini, Azure, AWS and GCP.
* Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and determine enterprise readiness.
* Experience designing reference architectures, engineering standards and delivery patterns.
* Strong market-sensing skills that convert frontier technology trends into a forward offering roadmap.
* Experience industrialising reusable offerings, accelerators and methodologies that differentiate at scale.

**Work model**
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role's business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

description:
**Company Overview**
KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
  
  
**Group/Division**
KLA advanced computing Labs’ (ACL) mission in India is to deliver advanced parallel computing research and software architectures for AI + HPC + Cloud solutions to accelerate the performance of KLA's products. ACL explores high-risk approaches, pioneering technologies, and novel methods to accelerate KLA’s algorithms and contribute to KLA’s HPC technology roadmap. **Software Engineer**
to join our dynamic team focused on

**.NET/Windows platform**
.

**robust, scalable, and high-performance software solutions**
.

* Experience in scientific computing, modelling, or computationally intensive applications.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

* Exposure to performance tuning, GPU programming, or compute-intensive workloads.
* Familiarity with UI/UX design principles and tools.
* Experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Windsurf).
* Exposure to semiconductor, metrology, or modelling domains is a plus.

**🔹**

* Opportunities to work on cutting-edge scientific modelling and engineering challenges.

Doctorate (Academic) with work experience of 0 years , Master's Level Degree with work experience of 3 years , Bachelor's Level Degree with work experience of 5 years

**Stakeholder Management & Leadership**

* Manage competing priorities and navigate ambiguity in complex transformation programs.
  
  
* Facilitate decision-making and proactively escalate risks, dependencies, and roadblocks.

**Responsible AI, Governance & Risk Management**

**Delivery Excellence & Business Impact**

title: Sr. Solutions Architect - Workday
description:
**Company Overview**
At Zuora, we do Modern Business. We’re helping people subscribe to new ways of doing business that are better for people, companies and ultimately the planet. It’s an approach resulting from the shift to the Subscription Economy that puts customers first by building recurring relationships instead of one-time product sales and focuses on sustainable growth. Through our leading expertise and multi-product suite, we are transforming all industries and working with the world’s most innovative companies to monetize new business models, nurture subscriber relationships and optimize their digital experiences.
  
  
**THE TEAM & ROLE**
Zuora’s Corporate Operations organization serves as the backbone of our internal technology ecosystem, building digital experiences that connect teams, align business priorities, and strengthen collaboration company-wide. Taking a cloud-first, AI-enabled approach, we empower our global ZEOs with modern tools and self-service solutions that drive productivity, scalability, and agility - all while upholding the highest standards of security and compliance.
  
  
Within Corporate Operations, the G&A Business Applications team designs, implements, and optimizes the systems that power all of Zuora's core General & Administrative functions, including Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success (HR), and Legal. Reporting to the Senior Business Systems Manager of Digital Workplace Experience, this team works closely with system analysts, administrators, project managers, data architects, and developers to deliver robust, scalable business solutions.
  
  
The Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems is a senior technical expert and data architect responsible for designing, building, and securing enterprise-grade data structures and integrations across our corporate systems ecosystem. This role functions as a critical cross-functional data and system integration specialist, ensuring seamless data flow, robust security governance, and scalable automation across diverse business platforms (e.g., Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more).
  
  
You’ll join a collaborative, high-performing team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth. Your work will directly impact the efficiency, quality, and scalability of Zuora’s enterprise systems and digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
**YOUR MISSION**
As a senior technical anchor supporting all G&A functions, the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems collaborates closely with leaders across Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal to establish a cohesive enterprise data architecture. You will build robust system integrations and leverage cutting-edge AI frameworks to drive efficiency, maximize data reliability, and enforce strict compliance across all internal platforms in alignment with strategic goals.
  
  
**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**
As the Sr, Solutions Architect - Finance Systems, you will play a vital role in the development, data architecture, and integration of Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal systems. Combining your expertise as a data architect and multi-platform integration specialist, you’ll ensure seamless data flow, scalable automation, and cross-system reliability without being tied to a single core vendor. You’ll work closely with functional BSAs to prioritize initiatives, refine user stories, and deliver enhancements through agile sprints, while supporting testing and deployment activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Lead integration support and comprehensive data architecture across core Finance, FP&A, Procurement, ZEO Success, and Legal business systems, ensuring cross-platform data consistency and process efficiency.
* Define and maintain end-to-end data models, data lineage, and integration patterns across all G&A applications, establishing a unified "single source of truth" bridging corporate finance, workforce analytics, and legal operations.
* Design, build, and optimize secure, high-performing API-based integrations, microservices, and file-based data flows (REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL) across Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, and more tools.
* Architect and implement AI-driven automation workflows; evaluate and integrate AI productivity tools and emerging standard frameworks—such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers—to safely expose internal tools and secure data layers to AI agents.
* Enforce strict data security policies, field-level encryption, masking, and access controls across integrated systems to protect sensitive workforce metrics (ZEO Success/PII), legal records, and financial data.
* Collaborate with cross-functional BSAs, business cross functional teams, and security teams using RACI frameworks to clearly map out data ownership, system accountability, and technical execution roles across different departments.
* Ensure configuration standards, technical architecture diagrams, and SOPs are up to date and fully compliant with internal controls, SOX, and global privacy standards (GDPR/CCPA).

**OUR TECH STACK:**
REST API, Webhooks, OAuth 2.0, SQL, JavaScript/Python, Coupa, Workday, NetSuite, Navan, Lattice, Greenhouse, AI Automation Tools, and MCP Server frameworks.
  
  
**What You’ll Accomplish**

* Deliver Modern Data Architecture: Transition fragmented cross-system data points from disparate G&A tools into a beautifully mapped out, resilient, and highly secure enterprise data model.
* Excellence in System Integrations: Establish scalable, automated data connections that allow Finance, FP&A, Procurement, HR, and Legal tools to communicate without operational friction, keeping sync latencies low and reliability high.
* Next-Gen Tech Adoption: Successfully implement secure AI extensions or MCP servers to optimize everyday business workflows and scale manual reporting processes down to self-service models.
* Advance Automation & Data Reliability: Develop solutions that strengthen data accuracy, eliminate manual tasks, reduce operational overhead, and increase system reliability across end-to-end business workflows.
* Promote Secure & Compliant Operations: Collaborate with IT, Security, and Audit teams to uphold field-level data protection, access controls, and strict compliance (SOX/GDPR) across all integration data layers.
* Establish Sustainable System Practices: Maintain clear documentation, SOPs, and configuration standards to ensure long-term scalability and consistent cross-functional operational excellence.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Architecture, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 8+ years of experience in system integrations and backend development (Proficient in REST APIs, SQL, JavaScript/Python, OAuth, and web services).
* Deep hands-on exposure to data structures and integration patterns within modern G&A systems—specifically covering tools across Procurement (Coupa), HR/ATS (Workday, Lattice, Greenhouse), and ERP/Expense (NetSuite, Navan).
* Proven understanding of LLM application patterns, AI integration tools, and modular protocol concepts like Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Solid understanding of data security standards, encryption practices, access control models, and IT/SOX compliance frameworks required when handling sensitive employee, financial, and legal records.
* Strong familiarity with project governance frameworks, including using RACI matrices to clarify cross-team responsibilities.
* Exceptional cross-functional collaboration and communication skills; the ability to elegantly translate complex technical and data architecture blueprints to functional business partners across completely different business disciplines.

**#ZEOLife at Zuora**
As an industry pioneer, our work is constantly evolving and challenging us in new ways that require us to think differently, iterate often and learn constantly—it’s exciting. Our people, whom we refer to as “ZEOs" are empowered to take on a mindset of ownership and make a bigger impact here. Our teams collaborate deeply, exchange different ideas openly and together we’re making what’s next possible for our customers, community and the world.
  
  
As Part Of Our Commitment To Building An Inclusive, High-performance Culture Where ZEOs Feel Inspired, Connected And Valued, We Support ZEOs With
  
  
Competitive compensation, corporate bonus program and performance rewards, company equity and retirement programs
  
  
Medical, dental and vision insurance
  
  
Generous, flexible time off
  
  
Paid holidays, “wellness” days and company wide end of year break
  
  
Learning & Development stipend
  
  
Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation match
  
  
Free resources and support for your mental wellbeing
  
  

* Specific benefits offerings may vary by country and can be viewed in more detail during your interview process.

Location & Work Arrangements
  
  
Organizations and teams at Zuora are empowered to design efficient and flexible ways of working, being intentional about scheduling, communication, and collaboration strategies that help us achieve our best results. In our dynamic, globally distributed company, this means balancing flexibility and responsibility — flexibility to live our lives to the fullest, and responsibility to each other, to our customers, and to our shareholders. For most roles, we offer the flexibility to work both remotely and at Zuora offices.
  
  
Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace
  
  
Think, be and do you! At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences and contributions matter. Everyone counts. Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.
  
  
Zuora does not discriminate on the basis of, and considers individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regards to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
  
  
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to assistance@zuora.com.

title: Senior Architect
description:

LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/hidglobal/mycompany/

If you excel at communication, collaboration, and unrelenting innovation, we want to talk to you. And if you bring dedication, positive energy and integrity to the table, you just might be the right fit for our team.

title: Director-Software Engineering-Unify Energy
description:
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Software Engineering to lead engineering for the Unify Energy platform. This role will provide technical, organizational, and delivery leadership for software and data capabilities serving the oil and gas industry. The Director will align engineering execution with customer and business priorities while advancing a secure, scalable platform that helps energy organizations manage high-value information, streamline operational workflows, and improve access to trusted data across the asset lifecycle.
  
  
The Director will partner closely with Product Management, business leadership, Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Data Engineering, Quality Engineering, Implementation, Customer Success, and other software teams. This leader will translate industry needs into an executable engineering strategy, coordinate cross-team dependencies, and ensure that product investments produce measurable customer, operational, and financial outcomes.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on strategic leader with deep experience delivering complex SaaS and cloud-native platforms, leading distributed engineering teams, and building data-intensive solutions for regulated or asset-intensive industries. Oil and gas domain experience is strongly preferred, including familiarity with upstream, midstream, or downstream workflows; land, lease, well, facility, and asset records; regulatory information; document and data onboarding; and integration with industry and enterprise systems.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams responsible for the Unify Energy platform and related software, data, integration, and automation capabilities.
* Own the engineering strategy, technical roadmap, execution plan, and delivery outcomes for Unify Energy in alignment with product strategy, customer commitments, revenue goals, and long-term platform direction.
* Build strong working partnerships with oil and gas business leaders, customers, Product Management, Implementation, and Customer Success to understand industry workflows, prioritize the highest-value problems, and convert business outcomes into clear engineering plans.
* Provide technical leadership across SaaS software engineering, cloud-native architecture, APIs and integrations, data pipelines, search and document services, analytics, workflow automation, and applied AI.
* Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, support, and continuous improvement.
* Drive delivery of scalable, secure, and maintainable capabilities that support energy information ingestion, normalization, indexing, classification, validation, search, retrieval, workflow, and reporting.
* Advance platform capabilities that enable Access to serve as a trusted steward of customers’ physical and digital information assets by supporting metadata management, intuitive search, filtering, navigation, and map-based discovery within the SaaS platform. Lead the data engineering capabilities required to ingest, organize, and enrich customer data so it becomes more accessible, useful, and valuable across oil and gas workflows.
* Guide integration strategy for industry and enterprise systems, including data exchanges, APIs, batch interfaces, identity services, content repositories, GIS or spatial data, analytics platforms, and customer-specific systems of record.
* Lead data engineering and data quality practices for high-volume structured and unstructured information, including ETL/ELT, metadata management, lineage, reconciliation, observability, and reliable downstream consumption.
* Guide responsible use of AI and machine learning to improve document understanding, metadata extraction, classification, entity matching, search relevance, workflow recommendations, quality assurance, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure solutions are designed with appropriate attention to cybersecurity, privacy, records retention, legal hold, auditability, data residency, regulatory obligations, customer controls, and business continuity.
* Establish outcome-based planning and measurement. Define engineering and business KPIs for major initiatives, including delivery predictability, quality, reliability, adoption, customer value, operational efficiency, and revenue or retention impact.
* Partner with Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Quality Engineering, Data Engineering, and Operations to establish technical standards, reusable patterns, release controls, service-level objectives, and operational readiness.
* Monitor portfolio health, delivery metrics, product quality, reliability, risks, dependencies, capacity, and technical debt; make clear tradeoffs and proactively resolve or escalate issues that threaten business outcomes.
* Continuously improve platform architecture, technical health, and integration patterns while protecting customer continuity and sequencing change based on value, risk, and delivery readiness.
* Support talent planning through hiring, coaching, performance management, succession planning, role clarity, and the creation of an accountable, inclusive, and customer-focused engineering culture.
* Represent Unify Energy engineering in executive, product, customer, and governance forums, providing clear updates on strategy, delivery performance, investment needs, risks, opportunities, and decisions required.
* Stay current with emerging trends in energy technology, information management, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data platforms, AI-enabled automation, SaaS architecture, and software delivery practices.

**First 6-12 Months**
The initial focus will be to establish a clear engineering and product delivery baseline for Unify Energy, strengthen alignment between customer needs and the technical roadmap, and improve execution predictability. The Director will assess the platform architecture, team capabilities, operating model, delivery commitments, reliability, security posture, technical debt, and customer integration landscape. They will work closely with Product, Operations, and customer-facing teams to confirm the highest-priority business and product outcomes and translate them into a focused, sequenced delivery plan.
  
  
Success will be demonstrated through clearer accountability, stronger engineering and product operating rhythms, improved delivery and quality metrics, reduced execution risk, deeper customer partnership, and measurable progress on the highest-value Unify Energy capabilities.
