title: Analyst, Algorithm Research & Development
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Measurement, Analytics and Control (MACH) division is KLA’s software powerhouse, responsible for developing high-performance software platforms that support semiconductor manufacturing. MACH delivers cutting-edge technologies in patterning analytics, modeling, and data science—empowering chipmakers to ramp next-gen devices faster and more efficiently. Our cross-functional team of research scientists, software engineers, apps engineers and process engineers are solving the industry’s most complex technical problems.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an intellectually curious and technically exceptional AI Engineer to join our Applied AI Research organization.
  
  
This role is designed for individuals who enjoy moving beyond application of established techniques and are motivated by solving problems that have no obvious solution. The successful candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with expertise in machine learning, statistical algorithms, deep learning, and agentic AI systems to create next-generation intelligence platforms for semiconductor manufacturing and engineering.
  
  
Unlike traditional software engineering roles, this position requires a strong research mindset. We are looking for engineers who question assumptions, derive first-principles understanding of problems, conduct systematic experimentation, and translate emerging research into practical business impact.
  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to grow into a future technical and research leader capable of influencing the direction of AI, analytics, and intelligent automation across the organization.
  
  
**Vision for the Role**
Over the next several years, this individual is expected to evolve from an AI engineer into a recognized research leader who:
  
  

* Shapes the organization's AI strategy through technical innovation.
* Drives a culture of experimentation and evidence-based decision making.
* Bridges cutting-edge AI research with real-world engineering applications.
* Identifies transformational technologies before they become mainstream.
* Inspires teams to pursue ambitious technical challenges.
* Builds an innovation ecosystem through mentorship, technical leadership, and collaboration.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Applied AI Research**

* Investigate emerging AI techniques and evaluate their applicability to semiconductor manufacturing and engineering workflows.
* Conduct hands-on research in areas such as:

+ Foundation Models
+ Agentic AI Systems
+ Scientific Machine Learning
+ Computer Vision
+ Reinforcement Learning
+ Probabilistic Modeling
+ Knowledge Representation
+ Multi-Agent Systems
+ Causal AI

* Develop novel approaches for solving difficult engineering and manufacturing problems.
* Design rigorous experimental frameworks to validate hypotheses and quantify impact.
* Translate research findings into scalable product capabilities.

**Statistical Learning & Algorithm Development**
Design and develop advanced algorithms utilizing:
  
  

* Bayesian Inference
* Probabilistic Graphical Models
* Design of Experiments (DOE)
* Time-Series Analysis
* Optimization Techniques
* Causal Inference
* Anomaly Detection
* Predictive Modeling
* Multivariate Statistics
* Graph Analytics

Responsibilities include:
  
  

* Creating explainable and scientifically sound models.
* Evaluating statistical significance of experimental outcomes.
* Building decision-support and autonomous reasoning systems.

**Deep Learning & Scientific AI**
Develop next-generation deep learning solutions for:
  
  

* Defect Management
* Yield Analytics
* Manufacturing Optimization
* Image Understanding
* Pattern Recognition
* Engineering Knowledge Discovery

Work with and innovate on:
  
  

* CNNs
* Vision Transformers
* Multimodal Models
* Graph Neural Networks
* Self-Supervised Learning
* Representation Learning
* Foundation Models
* Diffusion Architectures

Candidates should be comfortable reading research papers, reproducing published techniques, and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  
  
**Agentic AI & Intelligent Systems**
Develop intelligent autonomous systems capable of:
  
  

* Planning
* Reasoning
* Tool Usage
* Workflow Orchestration
* Long-Horizon Goal Achievement

Build sophisticated AI systems using:
  
  

* LangGraph
* Semantic Kernel
* AutoGen
* CrewAI
* OpenAI Agent Frameworks
* MCP (Model Context Protocol)

Examples include:
  
  

* AI Copilots
* Manufacturing Assistants
* Engineering Intelligence Platforms
* Autonomous Analytics Systems
* Knowledge Agents

**Software Engineering Excellence**
Develop production-grade solutions using:
  
  
**Primary Languages**

* Python
* Modern C++ (C++17/20)

**Additional Technologies**

* PyTorch
* Ray
* Spark
* Kubernetes
* Docker
* Vector Databases
* Graph Databases

The candidate should be able to transform research prototypes into scalable and maintainable products.
  
  
**Research Leadership Expectations**
Although this is an individual contributor role, the candidate is expected to actively contribute to building a research culture.
  
  
This includes:
  
  

* Leading technical reading groups.
* Reviewing and discussing recent research papers.
* Driving internal innovation initiatives.
* Mentoring junior engineers on research methodology.
* Promoting first-principles thinking.
* Encouraging experimentation and hypothesis-driven development.
* Establishing engineering rigor around benchmarking and evaluation.

Success is measured not only by feature delivery but also by the advancement of the team's collective technical capability.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
**Education**
MS or PhD preferred in:
  
  

* Computer Science
* Machine Learning
* Artificial Intelligence
* Statistics
* Applied Mathematics
* Electrical Engineering
* Related STEM discipline

**Experience**
Typically:
  
  

* BS + 5 years
* OR MS + 3 years
* OR PhD

Demonstrated experience in building production AI systems while maintaining strong interest in research and innovation.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate is someone who:
  
  

* Reads research papers for fun.
* Questions conventional assumptions.
* Enjoys tackling open-ended technical challenges.
* Can move seamlessly from theory to implementation.
* Has strong mathematical intuition.
* Is passionate about creating new knowledge, not merely applying existing solutions.
* Wants to become a future Principal Engineer, Distinguished Engineer, or AI Research Leader.

**What Success Looks Like After 3-5 Years**
This engineer will have:
  
  

* Become a recognized technical authority in AI and analytics.
* Influenced the AI roadmap for multiple products.
* Originated innovations that materially impact product differentiation.
* Built a thriving culture of experimentation and technical excellence.
* Mentored the next generation of AI engineers and researchers.
* Established KLA as a leader in AI-native semiconductor manufacturing intelligence.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

description:

  .

  , collaborate closely with stakeholders, data scientists, and platform teams, and translate business requirements into robust, secure, and scalable AI solutions.

  **technical expertise, solution architecture capabilities, and the ability to lead AI initiatives from Concept to Production.**

**Details of Employment:**

**Location:**
Chennai, India

**Work Location**
– Guindy Olympia Tech Park OR SIPCOT Siruseri.

**Mode of Employment**
- 3 days Hybrid in the Office.

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time, Permanent.

**Notice Period**
- 0 to 15 days from the date of the offer (
**Critical Requisition; hence the ask**
)

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI Architecture and Solution Design**

* Architect and lead the development of enterprise-grade RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, vector databases, embedding models, and retrieval strategies using Azure AI Search, FAISS, and Pinecone.
* Design and implement Agentic AI systems incorporating autonomous agents, multi-step planning, tool orchestration, reasoning workflows, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Develop AI solutions that integrate with internal systems, including trading platforms, operations workbenches, and risk engines, to automate decision support, exception handling, and reporting.
* Establish standards for prompt engineering, AI guardrails, and evaluation frameworks, including offline evaluations, A/B testing, and automated regression testing.

**2. Azure Cloud and AI Platform Engineering**

* Lead the design, implementation, and management of AI/ML infrastructure on Microsoft Azure using Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Design scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient AI inference pipelines using caching, request batching, and token-budget optimization.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML models and AI agents, incorporating model versioning, controlled deployments, A/B testing, rollback mechanisms, and observability.
* Ensure compliance with enterprise cloud governance, data residency, and security requirements using Azure Private Endpoints, Managed Identity, Key Vault, and related security controls.

**3. AI Performance Optimization and Troubleshooting**

* Diagnose and resolve production AI performance issues, including inference latency, embedding drift, retrieval quality degradation, hallucinations, and context-window limitations.
* Monitor and optimize token consumption, API rate limits, throughput, and cost per query across production AI workloads.
* Establish AI observability through structured logging, distributed tracing across prompt processing, retrieval, and generation, and dashboards tracking latency (p50/p95/p99), retrieval recall, and answer relevance.
* Conduct root-cause analysis of AI system failures, including incorrect tool invocations, RAG retrieval failures, safety-filter false positives, and model regressions following version upgrades.

**4. Technical Leadership and Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of 4–6 AI/ML engineers, overseeing code reviews, architecture decisions, sprint planning, engineering standards, and professional development.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, data scientists, quantitative teams, and operations leaders to translate business requirements into scalable, production-ready AI solutions.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, model releases, fine-tuning techniques, agent frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, and CrewAI, and AI evaluation methodologies.
* Represent the AI engineering function in technical design reviews, architecture governance forums, and incident post-mortems.
* Drive engineering best practices and continuous improvement across AI solution design, development, deployment, monitoring, security, and operational support.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 10+ years of software engineering experience, with 4+ years focused on AI/ML solutions in production environments.
* Deep hands-on experience with RAG architectures, including vector databases, embedding pipelines, chunking strategies, hybrid search (keyword + semantic), re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation.
* Proven track record of building Agentic AI systems, including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use patterns, planning loops, memory management, and fallback strategies.
* Strong proficiency in Azure Cloud services, including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search (formerly Cognitive Search), Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, AKS, and App Service.
* Experience troubleshooting AI performance issues, including inference latency optimization, token budgeting, embedding drift detection, hallucination mitigation, and cost management at scale.
* Proficiency in Python and at least one of the following: C#/.NET or TypeScript/Node.js.
* Experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI.
* Solid understanding of ML fundamentals, including transformers, attention mechanisms, fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA), RLHF, and evaluation metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, faithfulness, and relevance.
* Experience leading engineering teams of 4+ members in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and prepare clear technical documentation.

Resumes can be shared with
**devika.raju@kumaran.com**

title: AICTE Postdoctoral Fellowship in Neuromorphic Computing
description:
About Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham

Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham is a leading multi-campus, multi-disciplinary research university in India, nationally recognised for its research output and academic excellence. The university has eight campuses across five Indian states, with its headquarters in Ettimadai, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu.

Amrita runs regular student and researcher exchange programmes with top universities in the United States, including Ivy League institutions, and with leading European universities. It is one of the fastest-growing institutions of higher learning in the country. Fellows get an international outlook, modern facilities and strong institutional support for high-impact research.

About the Fellowship

Applications are invited for a full-time, on-site
**Postdoctoral Fellowship in Neuromorphic Computing**
, offered under the
**AICTE Postdoctoral Fellowship scheme**
. The fellow will be based at Amrita’s Chennai campus.

The fellow will join an interdisciplinary research environment spanning semiconductor physics, computing and engineering. They will carry out original research in neuromorphic computing.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct original research in neuromorphic computing, including designing and running experiments and developing models
* Analyse experimental and simulation data
* Carry out hands-on laboratory work and collaborate with faculty and research teams
* Prepare manuscripts for peer-reviewed journals
* Present results at conferences and internal seminars
* Mentor graduate and undergraduate students
* Contribute to grant proposals
* Support collaborative projects with national and international partners

Eligibility and Qualifications

**Essential**

* PhD in Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics or a closely related discipline, or equivalent research experience (subject to AICTE PDF eligibility norms)
* Strong research skills, including experimental design, literature review and scientific writing
* Laboratory skills relevant to neuromorphic computing or closely related areas
* A solid foundation in electronic devices, circuits and systems
* Competence in data analysis, including statistical methods, numerical modelling and relevant software tools
* Strong programming skills (e.g. Python, MATLAB or similar)
* Familiarity with simulation tools used in neuromorphic and device-level research
* Ability to work collaboratively in interdisciplinary teams
* Clear written and spoken communication of research findings in English
* Willingness to work on-site in Chennai and engage fully with Amrita’s research and academic community

**Highly desirable**

* Experience in one or more of the following:
* neuromorphic hardware
* computational neuroscience
* AI/ML for neuromorphic systems
* VLSI

title: Technical Lead
description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as a Technical Lead for Genesys Cloud solutions within a hybrid work model applying deep expertise in quality monitoring speech analytics and APIs to optimize contact center operations in auto claims and property and casualty insurance. Drive high impact technical initiatives that improve customer experience operational efficiency and compliance for a global organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead end to end technical design and implementation of Genesys Cloud solutions to support complex contact center workflows for auto claims and property and casualty insurance operations.
* Oversee configuration and optimization of Genesys Cloud quality monitoring features to ensure thorough evaluation of agent interactions and continuous service performance improvement.
* Drive development and integration of Genesys Cloud APIs to connect customer communication channels with policy systems and claims platforms in a secure and scalable manner.
* Provide hands on guidance in tuning speech analytics models to identify customer sentiment trends and claims related issues that inform business decisions and process enhancements.
* Coordinate with claims operations and underwriting teams to translate domain requirements from auto claims and property and casualty insurance into robust Genesys Cloud technical solutions.
* Implement monitoring and alerting mechanisms around Genesys Cloud services and APIs to ensure high availability low latency and rapid incident response in a day shift environment.
* Collaborate with cross functional stakeholders to design call flows routing strategies and interaction policies that improve claim handling efficiency and customer satisfaction.
* Execute structured code reviews configuration audits and documentation updates for Genesys Cloud components to maintain regulatory compliance and technical standards alignment.
* Analyze interaction data from quality monitoring and speech analytics to propose targeted improvements in claims handling scripts workflows and agent coaching programs.
* Guide junior engineers in best practices for Genesys Cloud development integration and troubleshooting while maintaining focus on customer and business outcomes rather than formal people management.
* Conduct impact assessments and proof of concept activities for new Genesys Cloud features or API integrations that can enhance automation in claims intake and policy servicing.
* Coordinate hybrid work collaboration using secure tools and standardized processes to ensure consistent progress across onsite and remote team members without travel requirements.
* Document solution designs technical decisions and operational runbooks clearly so that support teams can manage Genesys Cloud environments effectively during day shifts.

**Qualifications**

* Apply extensive experience of seven to ten years in enterprise contact center technologies with a focus on Genesys Cloud platforms quality monitoring and speech analytics to deliver reliable solutions.
* Demonstrate strong proficiency in designing and consuming Genesys Cloud APIs including authentication data mapping and error handling patterns for insurance domain integrations.
* Bring solid understanding of auto claims processes and property and casualty insurance lifecycles to shape technical configurations that align with regulatory expectations and customer service goals.
* Utilize practical experience in hybrid work models to manage time communication and collaboration effectively across distributed technical and business teams.
* Exhibit proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues in Genesys Cloud environments using logs metrics and analytic insights to restore service quickly and prevent recurrence.
* Apply knowledge of contact center metrics and key performance indicators to interpret quality monitoring and speech analytics outputs into actionable recommendations.
* Show comfort working with enterprise change management and release processes ensuring that Genesys Cloud updates and API changes are deployed in a controlled and documented manner.

title: Head of AI Division – Enterprise AI, Generative AI & Agentic Platforms
description:
Role Overview

Our company is seeking an accomplished
**Head of AI Division**
to lead its enterprise-wide Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Intelligent Automation initiatives. This is a senior leadership position responsible for defining the AI vision, building and scaling AI capabilities, establishing enterprise AI platforms, and driving measurable business transformation across the organization's engineering, product, and operational ecosystems.

The ideal candidate will bring 20+ years of experience across software engineering, enterprise architecture, technology leadership, and platform development, including substantial hands-on experience in designing and deploying production-grade AI and Generative AI solutions.

The role requires a unique combination of executive leadership, deep technical expertise, product and business acumen, and the ability to transform emerging AI technologies into secure, scalable, and commercially valuable enterprise solutions.

The Head of AI Division will work closely with executive leadership, Engineering, Product, Operations, Architecture, and Customer Success teams to establish AI as a strategic organizational capability, accelerate innovation, improve engineering productivity, and deliver sustainable business value.

Key Responsibilities

1. Enterprise AI Strategy & Business Transformation

* Define and execute Solartis' enterprise AI strategy, vision, and multi-year transformation roadmap.
* Identify opportunities to leverage Generative AI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation, and AI-powered decision systems across products and business functions.
* Translate business objectives into scalable AI initiatives with clearly defined outcomes, investment priorities, and measurable ROI.
* Establish enterprise AI reference architectures, technology standards, implementation frameworks, and reusable accelerators.
* Advise executive leadership on AI adoption, emerging technologies, investment priorities, opportunities, and associated risks.
* Drive an AI-first engineering and product development culture across the organization.

2. AI Division Leadership & Organizational Development

* Build, lead, and scale a high-performing AI division comprising AI architects, AI/ML engineers, Generative AI specialists, platform engineers, and research or innovation teams.
* Define the organizational structure, operating model, hiring strategy, capability development plans, and performance expectations for the AI division.
* Establish clear ownership and accountability across AI strategy, architecture, engineering, platform development, and production operations.
* Mentor senior technical leaders and develop a strong leadership pipeline within the AI organization.
* Foster collaboration across Engineering, Product, Security, Infrastructure, Operations, and business stakeholders.
* Manage resource allocation, delivery priorities, technology investments, and AI program budgets.

3. Enterprise Generative AI & Foundation Model Strategy

* Lead the evaluation, selection, architecture, and enterprise adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and open-source foundation models.
* Establish model selection, routing, orchestration, fine-tuning, inference optimization, and deployment strategies aligned with business requirements.
* Drive the adoption of platforms and technologies such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, and other relevant foundation models.
* Define strategies for balancing model performance, security, latency, scalability, licensing, and inference costs.
* Oversee the development of enterprise AI services, reusable frameworks, APIs, SDKs, and shared platform capabilities.

4. Enterprise RAG & Knowledge Intelligence Platforms

* Lead the architecture and implementation of enterprise-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) platforms and knowledge intelligence systems.
* Establish scalable architectures integrating structured and unstructured enterprise data, semantic search, embeddings, vector databases, and knowledge graphs.
* Drive improvements in retrieval accuracy, contextual relevance, response quality, grounding, and hallucination mitigation.
* Oversee enterprise knowledge assistants, AI copilots, intelligent search solutions, and domain-specific AI applications.
* Establish standards for data access, source attribution, information security, and evaluation of knowledge-grounded AI systems.

5. Agentic AI & Intelligent Automation

* Define the enterprise roadmap for autonomous AI agents, multi-agent systems, and intelligent workflow orchestration.
* Lead the design and deployment of AI systems capable of planning, reasoning, tool use, task execution, and controlled decision support.
* Drive Agentic AI adoption across software engineering, testing, customer support, business operations, and relevant domain-specific workflows.
* Establish frameworks for agent orchestration, memory management, human-in-the-loop controls, exception handling, and safe execution.
* Define standards for agent observability, evaluation, access control, governance, and operational reliability.
* Ensure that autonomous workflows operate within clearly defined business rules, permissions, and accountability boundaries.

6. AI Platform Engineering & Production Delivery

* Own the architecture, engineering, deployment, and scaling of enterprise AI platforms in production environments.
* Establish engineering practices for MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps, including CI/CD, model lifecycle management, testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Drive the development of production-ready AI applications using robust APIs, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native platforms.
* Establish end-to-end AI evaluation frameworks covering quality, accuracy, reliability, security, latency, scalability, and cost.
* Ensure AI solutions meet enterprise requirements for availability, resilience, performance, maintainability, and operational support.
* Maintain strong technical oversight of critical architecture decisions, engineering standards, and production implementations.

7. AI-Powered Engineering Transformation

* Lead enterprise-wide adoption of AI-assisted software development and intelligent engineering workflows.
* Drive AI-enabled code generation, code review, automated testing, documentation, developer assistance, and DevOps automation.
* Partner with engineering leadership to identify productivity bottlenecks and establish measurable improvements in software delivery.
* Develop frameworks to assess AI-assisted engineering quality, developer productivity, defect reduction, and delivery efficiency.
* Promote responsible adoption of AI development tools while maintaining software quality, intellectual property protection, and security standards.

8. AI Governance, Security & Responsible AI

* Establish enterprise AI governance frameworks covering responsible AI, privacy, security, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
* Define policies for model access, data protection, prompt injection mitigation, sensitive information handling, and AI application security.
* Ensure appropriate human oversight, auditability, explainability, and traceability for AI-assisted and agent-driven decisions.
* Partner with Security, Legal, Compliance, and Architecture teams to establish risk-based controls for enterprise AI adoption.
* Implement governance mechanisms for model evaluation, production approval, change management, incident response, and continuous monitoring.

9. Technology Innovation & Strategic Partnerships

* Lead AI innovation programs, technology incubation, proofs of concept, and enterprise-scale pilots.
* Evaluate emerging AI frameworks, foundation models, orchestration technologies, and industry developments.
* Establish strategic technology partnerships and guide build-versus-buy decisions.
* Convert promising AI experiments into scalable production capabilities with clear adoption and business-value criteria.
* Represent the organization in strategic technology discussions and provide thought leadership to executive management.

10. Portfolio, Budget & Business Outcome Management

* Own the AI division's delivery portfolio, investment priorities, resource utilization, and operational performance.

**Role Purpose**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect translates complex operational requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable solutions across Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET, Azure, APIs, data platforms and AI services. The role defines architecture, validates choices through working code, establishes reusable patterns and guardrails, and remains directly engaged in troubleshooting, CI/CD, release readiness and production improvement.
  
  
**Duties And Accountabilities**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect works across multiple projects in the World Bank Operations portfolio and is accountable for ensuring that technical solutions are successfully designed, delivered and operated for Operations staff.
  
  
From a work-program perspective, the role provides technical leadership, delivery oversight and practical guidance to internal staff and globally distributed vendor teams. The architect helps sequence technical work, resolves delivery constraints and ensures that implementation remains aligned with business priorities, enterprise standards and release commitments.
  
  
From a technical perspective, the role leads application, integration and data architecture; identifies solution components and reusable patterns; validates designs through working prototypes; performs quality and code reviews; and remains accountable for delivery at speed, scale and quality.
  
  
**Role Scope and Distinction**

* Acts as a senior technical subject matter expert for complex, business-critical solutions in the Operations Workspace portfolio.
* Balances strategic architecture with recent, demonstrable hands-on contribution to prototypes, code, integration, deployment and technical problem-solving.
* Leads cross-layer design decisions involving applications, workflows, data, APIs, identity, security, observability and AI-enabled experiences.
* Guides multidisciplinary teams and vendors, mentors architects and engineers, and raises engineering quality through practical standards and reusable implementation assets.
* Works across globally distributed business, product, architecture, security, data, platform and engineering stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture for Operations Workspace and related products, aligning business outcomes, enterprise principles, security requirements and delivery constraints.
* Define target-state and transition architectures, solution options, architecture decision records, integration contracts, non-functional requirements and implementation roadmaps.
* Review designs and code for scalability, resilience, maintainability, interoperability, usability, performance and cost effectiveness.
* Identify systemic risks and technical debt, propose pragmatic remediation, and guide Agile Release Train and product teams through implementation trade-offs.

Lead solution delivery teams through implementation, maintenance, release readiness and operational improvement of business-critical applications supporting Operations Workspace and related Operations product ecosystems.
  
  
Lead application and data architecture modelling, component identification and solution quality reviews, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles and approved technology standards.
  
  
**Dynamics 365 and Dataverse Engineering**

* Architect and implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse solutions, including data models, security roles, business rules, workflows, plug-ins, custom actions, Power Platform components and environment strategy.
* Design supported extension patterns using C#/.NET, the Dataverse SDK and APIs while minimizing fragile customization and preserving upgradeability.
* Guide integration of Dynamics 365 with SharePoint Online, Microsoft Graph, Azure services, enterprise data products and other operational systems.
* Define application lifecycle management practices for solutions, configuration, environment variables, connection references, test data and controlled promotion across environments.

**Hands-on Prototyping and .NET Engineering**

* Personally design, code, test and demonstrate proofs of concept, technical spikes, reference implementations and minimum viable solutions.
* Develop secure APIs, services, plug-ins and integration components using C#, modern .NET, ASP.NET Core and RESTful patterns.
* Validate architecture choices through executable prototypes, performance tests and failure-mode testing before major delivery investment.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across user experience, application, integration, identity, data and infrastructure layers, and support teams during critical releases.

**Integration, Cloud and Platform Architecture**

* Design API-led, event-driven and workflow-based integrations using appropriate Azure services, API management, messaging, serverless and container patterns.
* Apply identity-first design using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, least privilege, secrets management and auditable authorization patterns, including B2E and approved external-access scenarios.
* Define observability using structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, dashboards and actionable alerts across application and integration components.
* Collaborate with data and platform teams to connect operational applications to governed data services, analytics products and structured and unstructured enterprise information.

Design integrations with institutional systems and data platforms, including financing, trust funds, board operations, budgeting, SAP and enterprise data services, using supported APIs, events and workflow patterns.
  
  
Architect document and content-management integrations across Dynamics 365, SharePoint Online and approved cloud services, including secure storage, metadata, retrieval and downstream AI processing.
  
  
**Agentic AI and AI-enabled Operations**

* Design and prototype AI-enabled features and agentic workflows embedded in Operations Workspace, with explicit task boundaries, approved tools, controlled permissions, human review and failure handling.
* Integrate agents with Dynamics 365, enterprise APIs, documents, data platforms and business workflows using secure tool calling, structured outputs and reusable orchestration patterns.
* Apply retrieval-augmented generation, document intelligence and knowledge-grounding approaches where they improve operational workflows and decision support.
* Define evaluation, telemetry and guardrails for groundedness, task success, safety, latency, reliability and cost, and ensure Responsible AI, privacy, records and security requirements are addressed.

Partner with information security teams on architecture reviews, threat modelling, control implementation, security testing and remediation evidence required for production approval.
  
  
**Delivery Lifecycle, CI/CD and Engineering Excellence**

* Establish and improve CI/CD pipelines for Dynamics 365 solutions, .NET services, infrastructure configuration and AI components using Azure DevOps or equivalent enterprise tooling.
* Embed automated unit, integration, contract, security, regression and performance testing into delivery pipelines, with quality gates, approvals, release evidence and rollback approaches.
* Apply both the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and a governed AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC), covering use-case framing, data and grounding readiness, prompt and tool versioning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and change control.
* Create reusable templates, starter repositories, SDKs, reference pipelines, coding standards and implementation guidance that improve developer productivity and consistency.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Team Leadership**

* Translate operational needs into feasible technical choices and communicate architecture decisions and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Provide practical technical direction to internal teams and vendors, review deliverables against agreed architecture and quality expectations, and intervene hands-on where necessary.
* Mentor architects and engineers through pairing, design reviews, code reviews, demonstrations and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Partner with product leadership to sequence enablers, reduce delivery risk and ensure technical work results in measurable operational value.

Provide work-program oversight for internal and vendor delivery teams across locations, assess deliverable quality, remove technical blockers and hold suppliers accountable for agreed architecture, engineering and documentation standards.
  
  
Selection Criteria
  
  

* Master's degree with at least eight years of relevant experience, or bachelor's degree with at least ten years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, in computer science, software engineering, information systems or a related field.
* Substantial recent experience architecting and delivering large-scale enterprise applications using Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET and Azure.
* Demonstrated hands-on contribution to production solutions, including personal coding, prototyping, integration, troubleshooting and deployment responsibilities.
* Experience leading complex delivery across internal staff, vendors and globally distributed teams in environments with strong governance, security and operational requirements.
* At least seven years of experience developing and maintaining large-scale solutions using C# and the Microsoft .NET ecosystem.
* At least five years of experience architecting Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Dataverse solutions and integrations with SharePoint Online, Azure services and enterprise or on-premises systems.
* Proven experience leading large, complex technical deliverables and globally distributed development teams, including vendor or offshore delivery, in environments with shifting priorities and multi-layered governance.

**Required Technical Capabilities**

* Advanced Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse architecture, including data modelling, security, workflows, plug-ins, custom APIs, Power Platform extensibility and solution ALM.
* Advanced C# and modern .NET engineering, including ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, automated testing and secure coding.
* Strong Azure application architecture experience, including App Service, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, Application Insights, storage and container-based deployment patterns.
* Strong systems integration capability across APIs, events, enterprise applications, Microsoft 365 services, SharePoint Online and data platforms.
* Hands-on CI/CD and DevSecOps experience, including source control, branching, build and release pipelines, infrastructure/configuration automation, quality gates, secrets handling and rollback.
* Practical experience designing or implementing Generative AI and agentic capabilities, including tool calling, orchestration, retrieval, structured outputs, evaluation, observability and human oversight.
* Ability to apply SDLC and ADLC controls to move prototypes into secure, supportable and production-ready services.
* Strong security architecture knowledge covering identity, authorization, least privilege, data protection, auditability, threat modelling and secure integration.
* Ability to produce clear architecture documentation and to explain decisions, alternatives, risks and trade-offs to varied audiences.
* Hands-on experience extending Dynamics 365 using C#/.NET plug-ins, custom APIs, workflows and supported client-side technologies, with strong knowledge of Dataverse security, data modelling and reporting capabilities.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, including B2E and approved B2B scenarios.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Operations Workspace, operational process platforms, project or portfolio management solutions, or comparable enterprise CRM/workflow ecosystems.
* Experience with Angular or React and modern web application integration with .NET and Dynamics 365 back ends.
* Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel or comparable enterprise agent frameworks.
* Experience with document intelligence, enterprise search, RAG, semantic layers, knowledge graphs or governed access to structured and unstructured information.
* Experience with SAFe, Agile Release Trains, product operating models and architecture governance.
* Experience in international development, financial services or another regulated environment with strong privacy, security and audit requirements.
* Relevant Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, DevOps, security or architecture certifications.
* Working knowledge of enterprise data and analytics platforms, including data lakes, data warehouses, Power BI, Azure Data Factory, Databricks or comparable integration and analytics services.

**Recommended Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert or relevant Dynamics 365 certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert.
* SAFe for Architects (ARCH) and/or SAFe DevOps (SDP).
* Relevant Microsoft applied skills or certifications in Azure AI, Azure OpenAI or Copilot Studio.

As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:

title: Manager Engineering
description:
**Career Area**
Engineering
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Role Definition
  
  
The Engineering Manager – Data Science is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing multiple pods of data scientists and machine learning engineers while ensuring high-quality, timely delivery of data science products and platforms. This role partners closely with AI product owners, AI architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders to ensure data science solutions are technically sound, scalable, and aligned to strategic outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
People Leadership & Talent Development
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of data scientists and ML engineers
* Set clear performance expectations and support career development
* Foster an inclusive, high-performing team culture

Technical & Engineering Leadership
  
  

* Provide technical guidance across data science and ML solutions working closely with AI Architects
* Ensure adherence to engineering standards and MLOps practices
* Review model designs and deployment strategies

Delivery & Execution Management
  
  

* Own delivery execution and capacity planning
* Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery
* Manage risks, dependencies, and technical debt

Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with AI Product Owners and business stakeholders
* Communicate progress, risks, and outcomes clearly

Quality, Governance & Responsible AI
  
  

* Ensure solutions meet quality, security, and compliance standards
* Uphold responsible AI principles

Degree Requirement
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Post Graduate or higher is desired.
  
  
Skill Descriptors
  
  
**Engineering Management**
Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high‑performing technical teams delivering complex data science and machine learning solutions. Provides clear direction, sets expectations, and holds teams accountable for outcomes while supporting individual growth and engagement. Balances people leadership, technical oversight, and delivery execution in a fast‑moving environment.
  
  
**Data Science & Machine Learning**
Strong working knowledge of data science, machine learning, GenAI and statistical modeling concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and experimentation. Able to guide and review technical approaches, challenge assumptions, and ensure solutions are fit for purpose without requiring hands‑on model development as a primary responsibility.
  
  
**Delivery & Execution**
Proven ability to plan, prioritize, and execute work in Agile or hybrid delivery environments. Manages team capacity, dependencies, and risks to ensure predictable delivery of high‑quality outcomes. Uses data and metrics to assess progress, identify issues early, and drive continuous improvement.
  
  
**Communication & Collaboration**
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to non‑technical audiences. Builds strong partnerships with product owners, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders to align expectations, manage trade‑offs, and deliver value.
  
  
Software Development Life Cycle
  
  
Demonstrated knowledge of software and data science development life cycles, including experimentation, prototyping, production deployment, and ongoing operations. Understands the differences between research‑oriented work and production‑grade solutions and guides teams accordingly.
  
  

* Works within formal delivery and governance methodologies
* Understands phases, activities, dependencies, and key decision points across the life cycle
* Identifies common risks and quality considerations at each stage
* Interprets and guides technical documentation, design artifacts, and delivery plans

Artificial Intelligence
  
  
Working knowledge of artificial intelligence, GenAI and machine learning concepts, risks, and opportunities, with the ability to guide teams toward solutions that deliver business outcomes responsibly.
  
  

* Understands AI methodologies, capabilities, and limitations
* Guides teams in applying responsible AI principles, including fairness, transparency, robustness, and governance
* Keeps informed of emerging AI technologies and evaluates their applicability to business needs
* Supports the adoption of AI practices that balance innovation with risk management

Programming & Technical Literacy
  
  
Strong technical literacy across programming and data science tools sufficient to effectively review code, designs, and technical approaches.
  
  

* Able to assess code quality, maintainability, and architectural alignment
* Collaborates effectively with hands‑on engineers and data scientists
* Understands testing, version control, and deployment concepts
* Hands‑on coding is not a primary responsibility, but technical depth is sufficient to guide and challenge solutions

Technical Troubleshooting
  
  
Demonstrated ability to lead teams through complex technical and operational issues across data, models, and production systems.
  
  

* Guides investigation and resolution of data, model, and system issues
* Reviews logs, metrics, and system behavior to support root cause analysis
* Partners with platform and operations teams to resolve production incidents
* Ensures issues are documented, learnings are captured, and preventative actions are implemented

Note
  
  
This Job Description is intended as a general guide to the job duties for this position and is intended for the purpose of establishing the specific salary grade. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties, and effort required of employees assigned to this job. At the discretion of management, this description may be changed at any time to address the evolving needs of the organization. It is expressly not intended to be a comprehensive list of “essential job functions” as that term is defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act.
  
  
**Posting Dates**
October 16, 2026 - October 29, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

title: Principal Robotics Engineer
description:
**Who We Are?**

Cleantech Industry Resources accelerates United States solar, battery storage and EV projects by providing turnkey development as a service including 100% internal systems engineering. The company deploys a leading team that spun out of the largest solar power producer in the world. This team operates within a sophisticated suite of software to support projects from land origination, through to commercial operation.

**Location of Position:**

Chennai

**What We Offer:**

* Opportunity to join a top-notch, collaborative team of professionals
* Fantastic team environment and collaborative culture
* Professional development opportunities to grow into an industry leader
* Medical Insurance for the employee and family
* Spot Recognition bonus for exceptional performance
* Long Term Incentive policy
* Regular team outings, events, and activities to foster a positive work environment

**Our Commitment to Diversity**

At CIR, we are dedicated to nurturing a diverse and equitable workforce that truly reflects our community. We deeply value each person’s unique perspective, skills, and experiences. CIR embraces all individuals, regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or nationality. We are steadfast in our commitment to fostering a just and inclusive world through intentional policies and actions. Your individuality enriches our collective strength, and we strive to ensure everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered.

**Position Summary**

As a Drone and Robotics Engineer at CIR, you will develop and deploy automated solutions for inspecting and monitoring solar assets. You'll work with cross-functional teams to define use cases, integrate sensors and flight control systems (ROS/PX4/ArduPilot), and ensure safe, regulation-compliant drone operations. Your role includes analyzing imagery using AI/ML, maintaining robotic systems, and driving innovation through continuous testing and technology upgrades.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Define automation use cases and requirements:**
  Work with the automation and solar O&M teams to understand inspection and monitoring needs, translate them into robotics/drone system requirements and propose technical solutions.
* **Integrate hardware and software:**
  Develop flight control software and integrate GPS, LiDAR, thermal cameras and other sensors. Use ROS/PX4/ArduPilot frameworks to ensure reliable navigation and data capture.
* **Plan and execute inspections:**
  Plan flight paths and robotic missions for thermal imaging and visual inspections of panels, trackers and other infrastructure while complying with DGCA/UAS 2.0 regulations. Conduct preflight checks and ensure operational safety.
* **Process and analyze data:**
  High-Fidelity 3D Photogrammetry, Precision Point Cloud Generation, and Geometric Feature Extraction to process high-resolution and thermal imagery for hotspot detection, shading analysis and fault identification. Present results to stakeholders and integrate findings into maintenance workflows.
* **Testing and quality assurance:**
  Conduct laboratory and field tests to verify performance, identify mechanical/software issues and optimize system reliability before deployment.
* **Maintenance & troubleshooting:**
  Perform regular diagnostics, firmware updates and repairs on drones and robots. Establish maintenance schedules and keep detailed logs.
* **Compliance & documentation:**
  Ensure systems meet DGCA/FAA regulations and obtain necessary certifications. Produce documentation, standard operating procedures and training material for end-users.
* **Innovation & research:**
  Stay current with advancements in robotics, UAVs and AI; evaluate new sensors and technologies; and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and prototypes.
* **Collaboration and training:**
  Collaborate with software developers, GIS analysts and solar engineers; provide training to field technicians on robotic and drone operation; and communicate technical information clearly to nontechnical team members.

**Education Requirements**

Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or similar.

**Technical Skills and Experience**

**Software Proficiency:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or similar.
* 5+ years’ experience designing, building and testing drones or robots—preferably for infrastructure inspection .
* Experience in extracting geometric features from point clouds, such as roof pitch, façade dimensions, and calculating structural thickness from derived models."
* Expert-level proficiency in Photogrammetry and Point Cloud Processing: Deep, hands-on experience with commercial (e.g., Pix4D, Agisoft Metashape) or open-source photogrammetry software and libraries.
* Knowledge of AI/ML techniques for image and thermal data analysis.
* Proficiency in ROS/PX4/ArduPilot and sensor integration (RGB, GPS, IMUs, LiDAR)
* Understanding of UAS regulations and safety protocols (DGCA regulations in India, FAA Part 107 elsewhere).
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving; excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to work independently and in multidisciplinary teams.

**Psychosocial Skills /Human Skills/Behavioural Skills**

* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take ideas and run with them from concept to conclusion.
* Technical understanding of clean energy business processes
* Exceptional verbal and writing communication skills with superiors, peers, partners, and other stakeholders.
* Excellent interpersonal skills while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The physical demands of this job require an individual to be able to work at a computer for most of the day, be able to participate in conference calls and travel to team retreats on a time-to-time basis. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Work Conditions**

The work environment is usually quiet (normal city traffic noises are common), a blend of artificial and natural light, temperate and generally supports a collaborative work environment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

At Cleantech Industry Resources, we embrace diversity and uphold a strong dedication to establishing an all-encompassing atmosphere for both our staff and associates. Our choices in employment are free from any bias related to race, creed, nationality, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, physical limitations, veteran status, or any other legally safeguarded attributes.

Being an integral part of Cleantech Industry Resources means you can expect to be immersed in a realm of professional possibilities within a culture that nurtures teamwork, adaptability, and the embracing of all.

title: Staff/Senior Operations Engineer
description:
**Job Type**
Full-time
  
  
**Description**
**About CloudBees:**
CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.
  
  
Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.
  
  
CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.
  
  
Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
  
  
Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.
  
  
**About the Role:**
To support the delivery of CloudBees products (both internal and external), our Operations team designs, deploys, secures and manages a variety of software systems and the related GCP / AWS infrastructure that underpins these software engineering objectives. Our guiding principle is simple - “Make Engineering Faster”. Underpinning this are the challenges of security, process change, technical change that all must be met to varying degrees. Further, we are passionate about reducing the manual work that plagues IT teams - Engineering / Ops / Support / Security - and are empowered to re-engineer processes and technology to achieve those objectives.
  
  
We are looking for someone who:
  
  

* Is able to troubleshoot complex issues calmly.
* An open communicator, capable of bringing new ideas to the team
* Is able to learn from colleagues at all levels
* Understands, and is motivated by, rapidly changing technologies and has demonstrable competence with modern AI tools.

You are:
  
  

* self-motivated and enjoy solving problems
* excited by the opportunity to automate yourself out of recurring workable to self-organize and document your work and decisions effectively
* You will liaise directly with the software engineers across all teams, ensuring that decisions are agreed internally and externally to Operations and that they meet our technical and non-technical objectives.

How you’ll work:
  
  

* In a geographically distributed team (APAC, US, EMEA) of peers
* Choose your own work in tandem with the team, team-leader, and manager
* Flexible working hours - while there will be some core hours required for meeting with Engineering and Operations teams - much latitude is given in getting work done.
* Hybrid work based out of our Chennai hub

**Requirements**
**What you’ll Do:**
**Team-building**
- inside the team and across teams - you’ll be proposing new ideas and helping implement them
**Thinking**
- coming up with new ways of solving problems - and working with the team to prove them out and then implement them. Keeping up to speed with the latest technology, and proactively making use of tools like coding assistants and AI agents to accelerate your work.
**Documenting**
- describing problems, how your proposed solution solves those problems, and how your implemented solutions are operated.
**Optimizing**
- working with Engineering teams to optimize their build systems. Managing and developing tools which enable Engineers to ship faster.
**Defining**
- writing / modifying Terraform to handle our infrastructure, and helping teams define their infrastructure using our modules.
**Coding**
- you’ll be writing code in Golang - we occasionally write code in TypeScript, Python, and Groovy
**Securing**

* working with our security team to drive operational change in engineering teams
* working with our security team to drive organizational security changes (logging, auditing, monitoring, alerting)

**Observing**
- adding the right monitoring so that we are alerted before our customers notice, and not alerted when the system is able to heal itself
**Alerting**
- getting alerts and working with team members to solve the initial problem, documenting the problem and then working out how to stop them happening again
**DevOps / DevSecOps**
- We’re not “DevOps” engineers, but we do help our teams become more proficient in doing Dev and Ops (and embracing Total Ownership). We build the guard rails to help them do it safely and align tech-stacks across the company.
**What you will work on**
-
  
  

* IaaS - GCP, AWS
* AI tooling and automation - Claude Code, Codex, AWS Bedrock Agentcore, Software Factories
* Platform tools - Kubernetes, terraform, helm, docker
* Language tools - Golang
* Engineering tools - Jenkins, Backstage
* Operations tools - PagerDuty, DataDog

**Role Requirements:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or related field
* 8+ years working in a DevOps style environment - building automations, writing software, solving problems
* 2+ years working in AWS (preferred) or GCP
* 2+ years experience in a high level programming language (Golang / Python / Ruby / Java or similar)
* Experience of working asynchronously in a distributed team.
* Experience of contributing to your team’s technical strategy
* Strong self organization skills and communication skills

You have experience in:
  
  

* programming in various languages and domains
* Development with agentic AI and administration of tools
* the "modern Ops stack" (e.g. monitoring, alerting, cloud-based provisioning, Docker, Kubernetes)
* Linux systems administration
* cloud-based operations (GCP, AWS, or Azure)
* cluster orchestration and management tools (e.g. k8s / ECS / Terraform / etc)
* continuous integration / continuous delivery tools (Jenkins / Tekton etc)
* modern software engineering practices: code reviews, unit / acceptance testing, source control, etc.
* You have experience using work tools like GSuite, GitHub, Jira, Confluence, and Slack.
* Experience of managing and responding to production incidents

title: Business Data Insights Senior Specialist

The candidate should be comfortable working with business stakeholders, data scientists, BI teams, product teams, and technical teams to understand requirements, design scalable data and AI solutions, and deliver measurable business value end to end — from raw data to production-ready AI features.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role: Data & AI Engineer**

The role requires strong hands-on experience across both disciplines: developing ETL/ELT pipelines, transforming structured and semi-structured data, and ensuring reliable data availability, as well as building RAG pipelines, integrating LLM-based solutions, and operationalizing models with MLOps best practices.

* Working knowledge of Power BI or similar reporting tools, and knowledge of legacy ETL tools (Informatica, SSIS, Teradata, Oracle) will be an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Azure Databricks, SQL, and related technologies.

* Develop RAG pipelines and integrate LLM-based solutions with enterprise data sources and applications.
* Work with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured datasets, preparing them for both analytics and model training/evaluation.
* Develop data and model transformation logic using SQL, PySpark, Spark SQL, Databricks notebooks, and Python ML frameworks.
* Create and maintain reliable data flows and AI services across raw, curated, and consumption-ready layers, including production model inference.
* Perform data exploration, validation, reconciliation, model evaluation, and performance testing to ensure accuracy and reliability end to end.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, data scientists, BI developers, product owners, and architects to convert requirements into technical data and AI solutions.
* Support data migration, system integration, and AI feature rollout, from legacy platforms to cloud-based data and AI platforms.
* Monitor pipeline and model performance in production, troubleshoot failures, optimize processing/inference cost and latency, and ensure timely availability.
* Implement data quality rules, responsible AI practices, exception handling, logging, audit checks, and operational controls.
* Contribute to documentation of data flows, model architecture, source-to-target mappings, technical designs, and operational support procedures.
* Participate in E2E product lifecycle activities including design, development, testing, deployment, run support, retraining, refactoring, and decommissioning of outdated solutions.
* Continuously improve existing data and AI engineering processes through automation, standardization, and reusable components.

**Business And Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of both data engineering and AI/ML concepts — data pipelines, data integration, data modelling, model lifecycle, and cloud-based platforms.
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable technical designs spanning data and AI.
* Experience in working with data structures, storage systems, model architectures, data quality frameworks, and system integrations.
* Good understanding of enterprise data flows, upstream and downstream dependencies, and AI/reporting consumption patterns.
* Ability to quickly analyze existing data and AI solutions and recommend improvements, automation opportunities, or alternative approaches.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot issues across pipelines, databases, models, and application layers.

* Ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Good documentation skills, including technical design documents, model cards, process flows, data mapping, and support guides.

**General Skills**

* Strong team player with the ability to work independently when required.
* High ownership mindset with a focus on delivering reliable and scalable data and AI solutions.
* Open to learning new technologies and applying them to improve existing processes.
* Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.
* Ability to understand end-to-end business processes and data/AI dependencies.
* Good communication skills with the ability to explain technical data and AI concepts in a simple and clear manner.
* Proactive approach toward automation, optimization, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Graduate or postgraduate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications in Azure Data Engineering, Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Machine Learning, or generative AI technologies will be an added advantage.

**Cloud & Data Platform:**
Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks
  
  
**Cloud & AI Platform:**
Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI Studio, Azure OpenAI Service
  
  
**Programming & Querying:**
SQL, Python, PySpark, Spark SQL
  
  
**AI/ML Frameworks:**
PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, LangChain, Semantic Kernel
  
  
**Data & AI Engineering:**
ETL, ELT, data pipelines, data modelling, data quality, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, MLOps
  
  
**Vector Search & Data:**
Azure AI Search, FAISS, Pinecone, vector databases

Power BI, SSRS or equivalent visualization tools

description:

Verizon is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Principal Security Engineer to join our Data as a Service (DaaS) & Analytics team. In this senior individual contributor role , you will act as the technical North Star for our analytics engineering teams, driving the cloud-native automation strategies required to expose critical enterprise security data via robust APIs and interactive dashboards. This is an execution-focused, "hands-on with code" position. You will architect and build modern data products, leveraging the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem to design scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and serverless application architectures.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**

* Architecting and optimizing large-scale security data repositories within Google BigQuery, ensuring efficient partitioning, clustering, and storage tiering to support multi-terabyte analytical queries.
* Designing and implementing robust, low-latency data pipelines using GCP Dataflow services (Apache Beam) to ingest, transform, and aggregate batch and streaming data from disparate security sources into centralized data platforms.
* Designing and maintaining optimized data layers using the GCP Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL engine) to support high-throughput analytics and data consumers.
* Leading analytics engineers technically to architect and deploy production-grade automation solutions. Utilize GCP Cloud Run and Cloud Functions to build scalable, event-driven microservices and high-performance APIs that expose enterprise security data.
* Identifying opportunities to integrate AI/ML automation (e.g., Vertex AI, LLMs) to streamline manual data extraction, automate metadata tagging, and optimize pipeline orchestration.
* Driving the transition from standard visualization to a scalable data product model, establishing a comprehensive Looker dashboard catalog to streamline enterprise risk forecasting.
* Developing and maintaining a standardized semantic layer using LookML (Looker Modeling Language) to ensure data consistency, security access controls, and reusability across all security domains.
* Building comprehensive business cases and data models surrounding Enterprise Security Data Analysis and Reporting to drive long-term security investments.

**What We’re Looking For...**

* Proven experience architecting and developing solutions within Google Cloud Platform, specifically leveraging containerized deployments via Cloud Run and serverless computing via Cloud Functions.
* Deep technical mastery of Google BigQuery architecture, including nested/repeated fields, materialized views, and BigQuery Omni or ML capabilities.
* Hands-on experience building streaming and batch data processing pipelines using GCP Dataflow services.
* Advanced proficiency in writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Strong hands-on coding expertise in Python to perform advanced data analysis, data mining, DevSecOps automation, and pipeline orchestration.
* Familiarity with deploying AI-driven automation workflows to improve data pipeline resilience.
* Experience utilizing visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Thoughtspot) to build data-driven stories tailored for business users at all levels.
* Experience embedding Looker visualizations directly into serverless applications or enterprise API frameworks is highly desirable.

**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor degree in Computer Science/Information Systems or six or more years of work experience.
* Eight or more years of professional experience in data analytics, business analysis or comparable analytics position.
* Advanced proficiency in Python and writing complex, optimized SQL queries, with specific hands-on administration and optimization experience using GCP Cloud SQL utilizing the PostgreSQL engine.
* Ability to write SQL against a relational database in order to analyze and test data.
* Experience with modern DataOps/DevSecOps orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt, CI/CD pipelines) applied directly to data engineering.
* Working knowledge on Threat, Risk and Vulnerability Management is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of securing cloud data delivery layers (OAuth, OIDC, API Gateways) and enforcing data privacy/governance standards.
* Cloud Certifications

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Experience in technology leadership, architecture, and Agile methodologies.
* Communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Problem solving skills to develop quick yet sound solutions to resolve complex issues.
* Experience in driving AI automation, delivering high performing and scalable applications.
* Experience with DevOps CI/CD processes to automate build and deployments.
* Experience mentoring and coaching diverse teams.
* Experience in identifying and analyzing and finding RCA for Errors and working with cross functional teams like SRE and backend team
* Experience with analytical tools and DBs like Postgres, Looker , ELK, ETL tools
* Recognizing, tracking, and communicating issues, accomplishments, milestones to the team and business partners.
* Professional Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect certification.
* Good presentation and communication skills.

Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**About The Role**
**About Soar and how we build :**
Soar is building an AI-native home-financing platform for Saudi Arabia, and the AI-driven engineering system that builds it. Our product spans origination, credit decisioning, loan management, collections and investor products, all under SAMA regulation.
  
We build differently. Our engineers don't hand-write code; they specify, direct and review AI agents that do. If that sounds like where engineering is going, you'll fit here.
  
How we work :
  
Agents write the code. Engineers own the spec, the context, the tests and the review. DevOps doesn't hand-manage servers either.
  
Context engineering is the core skill. Agents work from a shared knowledge graph of business rules, architecture principles and money-movement rules that we keep current.
  
We build our own agents. Requirements, DevOps, PM and self-testing agents run on our MCP/A2A framework to automate the SDLC end to end.
  
Full stack by default. AI closes skill gaps, so engineers work across backend, frontend and infrastructure, with cross-domain reviewers.
  
Regulated means rigorous. Money-movement logic gets human review, every time. KSA data residency shapes which models and tools we use and where they run.
  
What every role here needs: you already use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) as your main way of working, not as autocomplete. You can show us real workflows you've built, where they broke, and what you changed.
  
**Role Summary:**
We rely heavily on AI to build, test, and improve software. We are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager who can lead a team of engineers working with AI agents, keep delivery focused, and ensure every release meets a high quality bar. You will combine people leadership with practical technical oversight and help your team become more effective every week.
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the team’s delivery from requirements through production, with clear scope, acceptance criteria, priorities, and accountability.
* Coach engineers to use AI agents effectively for implementation, debugging, refactoring, testing, and documentation; contribute directly when needed.
* Help the team break complex work into reviewable tasks, provide relevant context to agents, and validate results against product requirements.
* Review designs and critical code changes, challenge unsupported AI assumptions, and ensure changes remain understandable and maintainable.
* Embed automated tests, peer review, CI checks, security checks, and end-to-end validation into delivery; keep human review accountable for release decisions.
* Partner with Product, QA, and DevOps to resolve blockers, prepare releases, and address production issues and recurring defects.
* Run regular one-to-ones, give actionable feedback, support career growth, and manage workloads sustainably.
* Improve team practices using evidence from delivery lead time, escaped defects, reliability, and AI usage costs.

**Requirements**
**Requirements:**

* Typically 7+ years in software engineering and 2+ years leading engineers or managing a team; equivalent demonstrated impact is welcome.
* Strong hands-on experience building production applications, with sound knowledge of APIs, databases, testing, CI/CD, and cloud systems.
* Practical experience using AI coding assistants or agents to deliver production software and helping other engineers adopt them effectively.
* Ability to review and debug AI-generated code, identify missing edge cases, and select appropriate automated and human validation.
* Strong planning, communication, and coaching skills, with a record of creating clarity and delivering through a team.

**Nice to have :**
Experience building reusable agent workflows, integrating engineering tools through APIs or MCP, or delivering software in fintech or another regulated environment.
  
**What success looks like :**
The team ships tested features predictably, resolves issues quickly, and demonstrates improving quality and productivity. Engineers use AI effectively while understanding and owning the systems they deliver.
