title: AI Architect
description:
**AI Architect – Core Agentic AI**

Experience: 10–14 years total; 4+ years in ML/AI, including 2+ years building LLM and agentic systems in production

Function: Core AI Platform / Agentic AI CoE

Reports to: Head of AI / Chief Architect

Location: [Chennai / Bangalore] – Hybrid

Employment: Full-time

**Role summary**

The AI Architect owns the end-to-end technical architecture of our agentic AI platform: how agents reason, plan, call tools, remember, and stay safe at enterprise scale. You set the reference architecture, patterns and guardrails that every AI product team builds on, and you are the final technical authority on agent design choices.

**Key responsibilities**

**Architecture and design**

* Define the reference
  **architecture for single- and multi-agent systems**
  : orchestration, planning, tool use, memory, state, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints.
* Choose and justify agent patterns (ReAct, plan-and-execute, supervisor/worker, graph-based workflows) for each use case.
* Design the tool and integration layer, including
  **Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers**
  , function-calling contracts and enterprise API access.
* Architect retrieval and memory: RAG pipelines, hybrid search, vector and graph stores, short- and long-term agent memory.
* Set the model strategy: frontier API models vs. open-weight models, routing, fallbacks, fine-tuning vs. prompting, and cost/latency trade-offs.

**Platform, scale and reliability**

* Design for production: latency budgets, concurrency, caching, token cost controls, and graceful degradation.
* Define the LLMOps/AgentOps stack: tracing, evaluation, prompt and model versioning, observability and rollback.
* Establish evaluation frameworks covering task success, tool-call accuracy, hallucination rate, safety, and regression testing.

**Governance, security and Responsible AI**

* Build guardrails against prompt injection, data leakage, unsafe tool actions and over-permissioned agents.
* Define identity, authorization and audit for agents acting on behalf of users.
* Align designs with data privacy and AI regulation (e.g. DPDP Act, GDPR, EU AI Act where relevant) and internal Responsible AI policy.

**Leadership and influence**

* Run architecture reviews and write design docs, ADRs and reference implementations.
* Translate business problems into agentic solutions with clear ROI with product and business stakeholders.
* Evaluate emerging frameworks, models and vendors, and decide build vs. buy.
* Mentor senior engineers and grow architecture capability across teams.

**Must-have qualifications**

* 10–14 years in software engineering/architecture, with
  **4+ years in ML/AI and 2+ years shipping LLM-based or agentic systems to production.**
* Deep hands-on knowledge of LLM application design: prompting, function/tool calling, structured outputs, context management, RAG.
* Working experience with agent frameworks such as
  **LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex,**
  CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK or Claude Agent SDK.
* Experience with major
  **LLM providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock)**
  and open-weight models (Llama, Mistral, Qwen).
* Strong distributed-systems background: microservices, event-driven design, APIs, queues, async workflows.
* **Vector databases and search**
  : Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch.
* Cloud architecture on at least one of AWS, Azure or GCP, with Kubernetes and containerisation.
* Strong
  **Python,**
  working knowledge of Java, TypeScript or Go.
* Proven record of owning architecture decisions with measurable business outcomes.

title: AI Engineer – On-Premises AI Infra & LLM
description:
**Job Description:**
AI Engineer – On-Premises AI, LLM & Infrastructure

**Experience:**
1–5 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Job Overview**

We are looking for an AI Engineer with hands-on experience in developing, deploying, and optimizing AI applications on on-premises infrastructure. The candidate should have knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intent parsing, tool calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI orchestration, and GPU-accelerated computing.

The role involves working with locally hosted AI models and NVIDIA GPU infrastructure, including NVIDIA RTX 6000 Blackwell and L40S. The candidate will also be responsible for application containerization, Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization, performance optimization, scalability, networking, security, and maintaining reliable on-premises AI environments.

The ideal candidate should be capable of taking AI applications from development and experimentation through deployment, optimization, and production maintenance.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. LLM Deployment & On-Premises AI

• Deploy, configure, and manage locally hosted LLMs such as Qwen, Mistral, Kimi, and other suitable open-weight models.

• Work with inference frameworks such as Ollama, vLLM, and similar model-serving technologies.

• Deploy AI workloads on NVIDIA RTX 6000 Blackwell, L40S, and compatible GPU infrastructure.

• Optimize model inference, GPU utilization, VRAM consumption, response latency, and throughput.

• Evaluate model performance, tool-calling capabilities, accuracy, and hardware requirements.

• Implement quantization, batching, streaming inference, and other optimization techniques where appropriate.

• Troubleshoot GPU drivers, CUDA compatibility, memory allocation, and model-serving issues.

• Maintain local AI deployments with an emphasis on data governance, privacy, and reduced dependence on external AI services.

**2. RAG, Intent Parsing & AI Orchestration**

• Develop RAG pipelines for retrieving information from documents, databases, and enterprise data sources.

• Implement document parsing, text extraction, OCR where required, chunking, embeddings, vector search, and reranking.

• Build intent-parsing and routing mechanisms to identify user requirements and determine the appropriate processing workflow.

• Implement LLM-based tool calling and function calling to interact with APIs, databases, and third-party applications.

• Develop multi-step orchestration workflows involving retrieval, tool selection, execution, and response generation.

• Implement MCP servers and clients to connect AI models with compatible tools and data sources.

• Design and maintain centralized tool registries with tool definitions, input schemas, execution handlers, and permissions.

• Implement guardrails, validation, fallback mechanisms, error handling, and controlled tool execution.

• Improve response accuracy, contextual relevance, source attribution, and reliability.

**3. Backend Development & Application Integration**

• Develop backend services and REST APIs using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI.

• Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems, databases, document repositories, and third-party APIs.

• Build reusable connectors for data retrieval and authorized application actions.

• Implement asynchronous processing, background jobs, session management, and streaming responses.

• Develop modular services for model inference, orchestration, retrieval, and external integrations.

• Write automated tests, technical documentation, and deployment scripts.

• Collaborate with frontend and infrastructure teams to deliver end-to-end AI applications.

**4. Real-Time Voice AI & Conversational Systems**

• Develop AI-powered conversational applications supporting real-time voice interactions.

• Integrate speech-to-text, LLM inference, text-to-speech, and optional avatar animation.

• Work with technologies such as Faster-Whisper/Whisper, Kokoro TTS, MuseTalk, and NVIDIA Audio2Face.

• Build low-latency audio-processing pipelines and streaming conversational workflows.

• Implement conversation context management, interruption handling, session management, and error recovery.

• Optimize audio processing, inference latency, GPU utilization, and concurrent session handling.

• Integrate voice AI components with backend APIs and application interfaces.

**5. Microsoft Hyper-V & On-Premises Infrastructure**

• Provision, configure, and manage virtual machines using Microsoft Hyper-V.

• Deploy and maintain Windows Server and Linux environments for AI applications and supporting services.

• Configure virtual CPU, memory, storage, networking, and resource allocation.

• Enable and troubleshoot GPU access for virtualized AI workloads using supported GPU-P or passthrough configurations, depending on hardware and operating-system compatibility.

• Understand GPU virtualization requirements for NVIDIA RTX 6000 Blackwell and L40S platforms.

• Deploy AI inference services and supporting applications across virtual machines and physical servers.

• Configure virtual switches, network segmentation, firewalls, DNS, and secure service communication.

• Troubleshoot virtualization, GPU availability, driver compatibility, storage, and networking issues.

• Maintain infrastructure documentation, backup procedures, and operational runbooks.

**6. Containerization & Deployment**

• Containerize AI models, backend services, RAG pipelines, MCP services, and voice-processing components using Docker.

• Use Docker Compose or similar technologies to manage multi-service applications.

• Configure GPU access for supported NVIDIA-enabled containers.

• Manage environment variables, secrets, persistent storage, service dependencies, and deployment configurations.

• Deploy applications across Hyper-V virtual machines and on-premises GPU servers.

• Implement health checks, logging, monitoring, service recovery, and deployment automation.

• Maintain reproducible and reliable deployment environments.

**7. Performance, Scalability & Reliability**

• Benchmark inference latency, time to first token, tokens per second, throughput, and concurrent user capacity.

• Identify CPU, GPU, VRAM, storage, and networking bottlenecks.

• Optimize resource allocation for multiple AI models, applications, and concurrent users.

• Implement caching, asynchronous processing, queues, batching, and streaming where appropriate.

• Design reliable services with timeouts, retries, fallback mechanisms, and graceful error handling.

• Monitor GPU utilization, memory consumption, application health, and inference performance.

• Ensure AI applications remain scalable, maintainable, and reliable as workloads increase.

**8. Security & Maintainability**

• Implement authentication, authorization, role-based access controls, and secure API integrations.

• Configure TLS, reverse proxies, firewalls, and secure inter-service communication.

• Apply appropriate access restrictions to tools, documents, databases, and connected applications.

• Implement input validation, output validation, audit logging, and secrets management.

• Ensure that RAG retrieval and tool execution respect user permissions and tenant boundaries.

• Maintain clean, modular, testable code and well-documented infrastructure.

• Troubleshoot production issues and continuously improve system security and stability.

**Example Use Cases**

**The engineer may work on use cases such as:**

**1. Real-Time AI Companion**

Develop an AI companion that interacts with users in live, one-on-one sessions and answers queries through natural conversations. This may involve locally hosted LLMs, Faster-Whisper for speech recognition, Kokoro for speech generation, and MuseTalk or NVIDIA Audio2Face for avatar animation. The focus is on low-latency interactions, conversational context, GPU optimization, and concurrent sessions.

**2. Multi-Source Enterprise Chatbot**

Develop a chatbot that retrieves information from multiple authorized data sources and interacts with connected applications. This may involve Qwen 14B or Mistral models, document parsing, RAG, API integrations, databases, MCP, and a tool registry. The processing workflow may include intent routing, retrieval, tool calling, orchestration, guardrails, and response generation.

**Required Technical Skills**

• Python programming and backend API development.

• Experience with or understanding of LLMs such as Qwen, Mistral, or Kimi.

• Familiarity with Ollama, vLLM, or similar inference frameworks.

• Knowledge of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.

• Understanding of intent parsing, tool calling, MCP, and AI orchestration.

• Experience with Docker and containerized application deployment.

• Practical knowledge of Microsoft Hyper-V and virtual machine management.

• Understanding of NVIDIA GPUs, GPU memory, inference performance, and model optimization.

• Knowledge of networking, security, and application troubleshooting.

**Preferred Skills**

• Experience with NVIDIA RTX 6000 Blackwell, L40S, or comparable GPU infrastructure.

• Knowledge of CUDA, NVIDIA drivers, and GPU monitoring.

• Experience with GPU virtualization or passthrough in Hyper-V where supported.

• Familiarity with Windows Server, Linux, and virtual networking.

• Experience with Faster-Whisper, Kokoro, MuseTalk, NVIDIA Audio2Face, or related voice AI

technologies.

• Familiarity with MCP SDKs, LangGraph, or similar orchestration frameworks.

• Knowledge of OCR, reranking, hybrid retrieval, and document-processing pipelines.

• Experience with reverse proxies, TLS, monitoring, logging, and CI/CD.

**Candidate Profile**

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Hands-on approach to AI development, deployment, and troubleshooting.

• Ability to work across LLMs, backend applications, and infrastructure.

• Understanding of the trade-offs between model quality, latency, GPU requirements, and scalability.

• Ability to develop maintainable and secure AI applications.

* Willingness to learn emerging LLM, agentic AI, voice AI, and GPU technologies.

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AIA - AI Archictect- Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI Architect**
**Enterprise GenAI, Agentic AI and AI Platform Architecture**
**Career Family AIA - AI / GenAI / Agentic AI**
**Role Type Full Time**
**The opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced AI Architect to lead the design and delivery of secure, scalable and production-ready enterprise AI solutions. The role combines hands-on architecture with consulting leadership across Generative AI, Agentic AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI/ML, cloud platforms and modern application engineering. The architect will translate business priorities into target-state architectures, reusable patterns and implementation roadmaps while guiding multidisciplinary teams from discovery through deployment and operationalization.
  
  
The ideal candidate has delivered enterprise or client-facing AI solutions in pre-production or production environments and can explain the use case, architecture, personal contribution, controls, delivery approach and outcomes. Certifications, personal projects and demonstrations alone are not sufficient.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead discovery and architecture workshops, clarify business outcomes and non-functional requirements, and convert them into scalable AI solution designs and delivery roadmaps.
* Architect LLM applications, copilots, RAG and Graph RAG solutions, autonomous agents, multi-agent workflows, tool/function calling, memory patterns and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Define reference architectures and reusable patterns for document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, grounding, prompt workflows, model routing and enterprise integrations.
* Select fit-for-purpose models, cloud services, vector stores, orchestration frameworks and evaluation approaches based on security, quality, latency, cost, scalability and maintainability requirements.
* Design API-first, event-driven and microservices-based integrations with enterprise applications, data platforms, workflow systems and user experience layers.
* Establish AI evaluation and observability covering retrieval quality, groundedness, accuracy, hallucination risk, agent trajectories, tool execution, latency, cost and user experience.
* Embed Responsible AI, privacy, security and compliance controls including PII protection, access control, auditability, prompt-injection mitigation, content safety, secure tool execution and data-leakage prevention.
* Define cloud-native deployment and operations patterns using containers, Kubernetes or managed services, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, model/LLM operations, monitoring and release controls.
* Lead architecture reviews, technical design reviews, code reviews and production-readiness assessments; troubleshoot complex issues and guide performance optimization.
* Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, data scientists, engineers, UX teams, security and platform teams to ensure alignment from design through adoption.
* Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, estimates, executive presentations, accelerators, reusable assets and AI practice development.
* Lead and mentor architects and engineers, promote engineering standards, and build capability through coaching and knowledge sharing.

**Skills And Attributes**
**Professional experience**

* 10+ years of experience in AI, data, analytics, software engineering or digital transformation, including significant responsibility for solution architecture and end-to-end delivery.
* Strong hands-on experience designing and deploying enterprise-scale AI/ML, GenAI, RAG or Agentic AI solutions in client-facing environments.
* Proven experience leading cross-functional teams, architecture governance, stakeholder engagement and complex delivery programs.
* Ability to communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs and business value to technical and executive audiences.

**Technical Skills**

* Deep understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, Graph RAG, Agentic RAG, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, knowledge graphs, model evaluation and fine-tuning approaches.
* Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI or Google Agent SDK, and familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Strong experience with at least one enterprise cloud AI ecosystem: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI; AWS Bedrock; or GCP Vertex AI and Gemini. Multi-cloud exposure is preferred.
* Experience with data and AI platforms such as Databricks, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, BigQuery or equivalent enterprise data services.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL; working knowledge of REST APIs, FastAPI, JSON, asynchronous processing, microservices and event-driven architecture.
* Experience with vector databases, enterprise search, relational and NoSQL data stores, caching and analytics stores.
* Understanding of ML, deep learning, NLP, predictive analytics and the end-to-end AI lifecycle.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShift, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure as code, MLOps, LLMOps, observability and production support.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture, data governance, model risk, Responsible AI, privacy, cybersecurity, accessibility and regulatory controls.

**Consulting And Leadership Skills**

* Strong client engagement, workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, presentation and executive communication skills.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into practical, high-quality technical architectures and phased implementation plans.
* Leadership in solution estimation, delivery governance, risk management, quality assurance, mentoring and capability building.
* Curiosity, structured problem-solving, commercial awareness and commitment to continuous learning.

**Education And Preferred Certifications**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative discipline.
* Relevant certifications in Azure AI, AWS, Google Cloud, Databricks, AI/ML, Generative AI or enterprise architecture are preferred.

**Why join us**

* Be at the forefront of AI-driven innovation across multiple client sectors.
* Work with global clients to deliver measurable business impact.
* Collaborate with AI experts, analytics leaders and industry specialists in a highly entrepreneurial environment.

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations - Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK - and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We provide the tools and flexibility so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We provide insights, coaching and confidence to help you become the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be empowered to use your voice and help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Staff Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
  
  
Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
****cut carbon****
.
  
  
**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**

* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all.
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.

Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy
* Apart from Fixed Base Salary potential candidates are eligible for following benefits


+ Flexible Leave Policy
+ Office located in the heart of the city in case you need to step in for any purpose

* We provide comprehensive coverage including accident policy and life insurance.
* Medical Insurance (1+5 Family Members)
* Flexible Benefit Plan
* Awards and Bonus
* Annual performance cycle
* Quarterly engagement activities
* A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, teamwork, trust, and efficiency

**What We’re Looking For**
We are seeking a
****Senior Staff Engineer (L6)****
to join Core Engineering in India as a senior individual contributor operating across squads rather than inside one. You will be the technical subject matter expert our teams pull in when the problem is hard, the design is ambiguous, or the blast radius is large — moving between our Acquisition, Extraction and Storage, and Presentment squads as priorities shift.
  
  
This role exists because our squads are shipping faster than our design review capacity. We have driven deep adoption of AI-assisted development across India engineering, and the constraint has moved: teams can now produce architecture and implementations quickly, but senior validation of those designs concentrates on too few people. You will be one of a small number of engineers trusted to review and approve significant designs, and to raise the design ceiling of the engineers around you.
  
  
You will not have direct reports. Your influence comes from technical depth, design judgment, and mentorship rather than reporting lines. This is a hybrid, remote-first role anchored in Chennai, working daily with US-based engineering and product partners.
  
  
Our engineering values are deeply ingrained in our culture — you can read more about them here.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Act as the floating technical SME across Core Engineering squads, embedding where the hardest current problem is and moving on once the team is self-sufficient
* Review and approve component and service designs, sharing design authority with squad leads so that architecture approval stops being a single-person bottleneck
* Own the design of complex, cross-service changes spanning multiple owners — provider data model changes, extraction pipeline evolution, migrations, and event contract changes
* Write production code on the critical path. This is a hands-on role; you will be in the repositories, not only in documents
* Set and raise the bar on non-functional requirements: performance, scalability, reliability, observability, and cost across the services you touch
* Validate AI-generated designs and implementations, reviewing agent output for architectural soundness, hidden coupling, and failure modes the model did not consider
* Advance how we do AI-assisted engineering: spec-driven development, reusable skills and subagents, prompt patterns that hold up against our codebase, and automation of recurring work
* Mentor Staff Engineers and below through pairing, design review, and constructive feedback, measurably lifting the technical judgment of the squads you rotate through
* Lead major refactoring and technical debt reduction across legacy platform services, sequencing the work so that delivery continues
* Debug and resolve complex production issues that cross service, data, and infrastructure boundaries
* Write the design documents, architecture decision records, and runbooks that make your decisions durable. Confluence is our single source of truth
* Partner with US engineering leads on cross-region initiatives, representing India engineering in architecture discussions

**What Will Help You Succeed**
The following list reflects our current technology stack. You will need meaningful overlap or analogous experience, but not an exact match.
  
  
****Must-haves****

* 10–12+ years in software engineering, with a track record of owning technically complex, multi-service work end to end
* Deep production expertise in Python, plus working fluency in a second ecosystem such as Java and Spring Boot or TypeScript/Node
* Strong distributed systems and event-driven architecture experience — queues, streams, idempotency, eventual consistency, and backpressure
* Hands-on AWS (ECS/EKS, S3, Lambda, Kinesis or equivalent) and containerized deployment on Kubernetes
* Solid relational data modeling and query tuning (MySQL, Postgres), plus search or analytical stores (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, Snowflake)
* Demonstrated ability to review other people’s designs and improve them. You can point to architectures that are better because you were in the room
* Practical, daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor, and of spec-driven development, with a clear view of where they help and where they mislead
* Credibility without authority: able to influence squads you are not part of, and to mentor senior engineers without managing them
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and comfort operating across India and US time zones
* Comfort with ambiguity and rotation — the willingness to be reassigned to the highest-value problem rather than owning one fixed surface

****Nice to have****

* Utility, energy, or fintech data domain experience
* Web data acquisition at scale (Puppeteer, headless Chrome, anti-bot mitigation)
* Document extraction, OCR, or LLM-based extraction pipelines
* dbt and analytics engineering on Snowflake
* Experience modernizing legacy monoliths into services while keeping delivery running

****Eliminating carbon footprints, eliminating carbon copies.****
Here at Arcadia, we cultivate diversity, celebrate individuality, and believe unique perspectives are key to our collective success in creating a clean energy future. Arcadia is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. While we are currently unable to consider candidates who will require visa sponsorship, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates eligible to work in India.

title: Director - Principal Data Engineering Lead
description:
**Job Title: Director - Principal Data Engineering Lead**
**GCL: F**
**Location: Chennai**
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to turn the latest AI breakthroughs into resilient, production-grade systems that accelerate late-stage scientific discovery and move life-changing medicines closer to patients? Can you picture yourself setting enterprise-wide Data and AI strategy while building reusable autonomous frameworks and GenAI capabilities that scale with confidence?
  
  
In this role, you will lead how we embed intelligence into the digital backbone of drug development. You will develop long-term platform funding priorities, capability roadmaps, and technology choices. Then you will translate strategy into solutions that make complex enterprise workflows simpler, safer, and faster for our scientists and product teams.
  
  
Join us at a pivotal point in our transformation into a digital and data-led enterprise. Backed by investment and an ecosystem of partners, you will work across AI science, engineering and business partners to create patterns that become the standard and prove them through high-impact deliveries that stand up in a regulated environment.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Shape and evolve the long-term Data and AI strategy for drug development, including platform investments, capability roadmaps, technology choices and alignment with enterprise architecture.
* Partner with AI science teams to design reusable agentic patterns, GenAI components and scalable solutions that streamline sophisticated enterprise workflows and accelerate delivery.
* Influence enterprise architecture decisions and lead strategic vendor evaluations, pilots and ecosystem partnerships to bring the best technologies into the enterprise.
* Lead multi-functional engineering teams, driving end-to-end delivery from prototype to robust, compliant production systems.
* Define, govern and promote engineering standards, guidelines and reusable design patterns; produce and review detailed technical designs across data models, APIs, integrations, security, deployment, error handling, performance, monitoring, testing and support.
* Promote strong data integrity and governance, including clear ownership, quality management, metadata, lineage, audit trails, master and reference data, and standardized terminology.
* Establish and maintain AI and ML governance controls, covering risk assessment, proper use, human oversight, explainability, model approval, versioning, performance monitoring, change control and retirement.
* Implement production-grade controls for GenAI and retrieval-augmented generation solutions to deliver reliable, traceable and secure outputs based on trusted information, including prompt and model management, response quality testing, source referencing, access controls and mitigations for prompt attacks and data leakage.
* Define and operate comprehensive evaluation and monitoring frameworks that track accuracy, reliability, security, response quality, business relevance, degradation, latency, cost and operational stability.
* Establish API-based and event-driven integration standards, including data formats, contracts, versioning, interoperability and integration with legacy and regulated systems.
* Improve value from enterprise data platforms and guide the implementation of DevOps, DataOps and MLOps practices to deliver resilient, automated, auditable pipelines across data, ML and AI.
* Ensure data solutions adhere to FAIR principles—findable, accessible, interoperable and reusable—and support end-to-end machine learning and AI workflows.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, experimentation, collaboration, and innovation across engineering and AI teams, encouraging thoughtful use of AI and digital tools in day-to-day work.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Track record of leading end-to-end delivery of AI-native products within a controlled or enterprise environment.
* Demonstrable ability translating research advances in GenAI or agent-based systems into scalable industrial solutions.
* Deep knowledge of modern cloud and data architecture patterns: microservices, serverless, etc.
* Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), SQL/NoSQL databases, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Fluency in Python, with a good understanding of secure software engineering practices.
* Experience mentoring engineers and leading high-performing teams.
* Comfortable influencing senior partners and shaping technology strategy across functions.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Pharma industry experience, particularly in R&D or Late-Stage Development.
* AI or Gen AI technical certifications or equivalent.
* AWS Cloud Certification or equivalent.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca**
Here, your work directly accelerates the development of life-changing medicines by pairing leading science with modern data platforms, analytics and AI. You will join a community that brings unconventional combinations of expertise together to spark bold thinking, supported by real investment and the freedom to experiment—from hackathons to high-impact deliveries in production. We value kindness alongside ambition, recognize meaningful contributions and create space for diverse minds to collaborate, learn fast and shape how an entire enterprise uses data and AI to create patient impact.
  
  
**Call To Action**
Step into this role to architect the AI foundations of drug development and amplify your impact—share your profile and start shaping what’s next.
  
  
**Date Posted**
13-Oct-2026
  
  
**Closing Date**
AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

title: Lead - Solution Engineer
description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
  
  
  
  
**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**
  
  
  
At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.
  
  
  
  
***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us***

**Job Description**

Freshservice is expanding what “AI-driven ITSM” means for our customers — from Freddy AI Copilot and Freddy AI Agent, to Agent Studio for building custom agentic workflows, to MCP Gateway connecting Freshservice to the broader AI stack. We're creating a new kind of Solutions Engineering role to match: the Lead AI Solution Engineer.

This is a specialist presales role for someone who can do three things at once: speak credibly to technical and business buyers about AI value, architect and demo AI solutions on top of Freshservice, and stay hands-on enough to help customers get those solutions live post-sale. You'll be the AI subject-matter expert embedded in SMB and Commercial deals, partnering with Account Executives, core SEs, Product, and Professional Services to win competitive deals and make sure the AI value we sell is the AI value customers actually realize.

You'll report into the Solutions Engineering leadership team and act as a force multiplier for the broader SE org — enabling peers, building reusable AI demo assets, and representing the voice of the customer back to Product on where our AI roadmap needs to go next.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the technical narrative for AI/Freddy across strategic and competitive deals — positioning Freddy AI Copilot, Freddy AI Agent, Agent Studio, and MCP Gateway against how prospects actually work today, not a generic AI pitch.
* Design and deliver tailored AI proofs-of-concept and demos: configuring agentic workflows, custom skills, and automations in Agent Studio, and connecting Freshservice to customer data and tools via MCP Gateway and APIs.
* Lead technical discovery specifically for AI use cases — ticket deflection, agent-assist, workflow automation, knowledge management — quantifying expected impact (deflection rate, resolution time, agent productivity) with the customer, not just for them.
* Lead internal projects that improve Solution Engineering efficiency and productivity, identifying repetitive processes and building AI driven workflows to simplify or automate them.
* Partner with Account Executives and core Solution Engineers as the AI overlay specialist on SMB, Commercial and competitive pursuits, joining deals at the point where AI differentiation matters most.
* Support deal-winning activities end to end: RFP/RFI responses, executive briefings, proof-of-value engagements, and security/architecture reviews for AI components (data handling, model governance, integration security).
* Bridge presales to delivery: work with Professional Services and Customer Success to help scope and de-risk the implementation of AI solutions sold, so what was demoed is what gets deployed.
* Build and maintain a library of reusable AI demo environments, reference architectures, and ROI/business-case models that the wider SE team can self-serve.
* Track competitive AI positioning versus ServiceNow (Now Assist), SysAid, Quest KACE, and other ITSM/ITAM players — including where competitors are genuinely ahead, so the team's positioning stays credible rather than one-sided.
* Represent customer and field feedback on AI features and gaps directly to Product and Engineering, influencing roadmap prioritization.
* Mentor and enable other SEs on AI positioning, demo technique, and objection handling as the internal go-to expert.

**Qualifications**

**What You'll Bring**

* 8+ years in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Consulting, or Technical Presales, ideally within ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, or broader enterprise SaaS.
* Strong AI fundamentals. You deeply understand how LLMs and agents work in production: context engineering, memory, RAG, tool use, structured outputs, and the failure modes that actually show up at scale. You've worked with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, or equivalent) and with both open and closed source models.
* Hands-on experience deploying or configuring AI/LLM-based solutions in a customer-facing context — this can be conversational AI/copilots, RAG-based knowledge assistants, or agentic workflow automation; deep AI/ML research experience is required.
* Hands on expectations around building internal agents and automations. For example, creating agents that can interact with multiple internal systems, collect and consolidate information from different sources, reason across that context, and provide actionable recommendations or trigger downstream workflows.
* A track record of selling and positioning AI or automation value to both business stakeholders (ROI, productivity, risk) and technical stakeholders (architecture, security, integration). Experience building production-grade machine learning deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Experience running competitive deals and building honest, differentiated positioning rather than one-size-fits-all pitches.
* Comfort operating across the full deal lifecycle — from discovery and demo through proof-of-value and into implementation handoff.
* Excellent executive presence and communication skills; able to flex a technical AI conversation up to a CIO/CX-leader audience or down to a hands-on admin audience in the same week.
* Freshservice, Freshdesk, or comparable ITSM/CX platform experience (ServiceNow, SysAid, Zendesk, Jira Service Management) is a strong plus.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience with Freddy AI, Agent Studio, or Freshworks products specifically.
* Experience with ITAM/discovery tooling (e.g., Device42) and how it feeds AI-driven automation.
* Exposure to AI governance conversations (data residency, model risk, responsible AI) in regulated industries.
* A builder's instinct — you'd rather stand up a working demo than a slide.

**Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

title: Perception Autonomy Engineer
description:
**Career Area**
Technology, Digital and Data
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Role Definition
  
  
Caterpillar’s Cat Technology team is seeking a Perception Developer to design, develop, and deploy perception software for autonomous and semi-autonomous machines used in construction. The role focuses on multi-sensor perception, computer vision, 3D point-cloud processing, sensor fusion, and production-quality software for safety-critical, resource-constrained platforms. The ideal candidate combines strong C++/Python development skills with hands-on experience building, optimizing, and validating perception algorithms from prototype through field deployment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement perception algorithms for object and personnel detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, terrain understanding, localization, mapping, and obstacle assessment.
* Develop camera, LiDAR, radar, GNSS, and IMU processing pipelines, including calibration, synchronization, sensor fusion, and uncertainty handling.
* Translate research concepts and state-of-the-art models into robust, maintainable, production-quality C++ and Python software.
* Optimize algorithms and neural-network inference for embedded CPU/GPU platforms using profiling, CUDA, TensorRT, and related acceleration technologies.
* Build automated evaluation workflows, datasets, simulation scenarios, and test tools to measure accuracy, latency, robustness, and safety performance.
* Debug and resolve perception issues using recorded data, simulation, hardware-in-the-loop systems, and field-machine testing.
* Collaborate with systems, autonomy, controls, embedded software, validation, and safety teams to define interfaces and deliver integrated machine capabilities.
* Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical documentation, and continuous improvement of software engineering practices.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
* Strong programming skills in modern C++ and Python, with experience developing and debugging software on Linux.
* Practical experience with computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry, point-cloud processing, or robotic perception.
* Experience with one or more perception tasks such as detection, segmentation, classification, tracking, localization, mapping, or sensor fusion.
* Working knowledge of PyTorch or TensorFlow and common perception libraries such as OpenCV, PCL, Eigen, or similar tools.
* Understanding of camera, LiDAR, radar, GNSS, and IMU sensor characteristics, calibration, coordinate systems, and data quality considerations.
* Experience with ROS/ROS 2, DDS, Git, unit testing, continuous integration, and software documentation practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills, with the ability to work across research and product-development teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience deploying perception models on embedded or edge platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, DRIVE, or comparable hardware.
* Experience with CUDA, TensorRT, model quantization, profiling, and real-time performance optimization.
* Knowledge of SLAM, visual or LiDAR odometry, Kalman filtering, probabilistic estimation, and graph-based spatial data structures.
* Experience developing perception systems for autonomous vehicles, ADAS, mobile robots, mining, construction, or off-highway equipment.
* Experience with simulation, synthetic data, dataset curation, annotation workflows, MLOps, or field validation.
* Publications, patents, or demonstrated implementation of state-of-the-art perception methods are an advantage.

Be Part of What’s Next in Autonomous Construction Sites
  
  
Construction autonomy is one of the most complex challenges in applied AI, and at Caterpillar, advancements in physical AI, simulation, sensing, and edge computing are turning things that once felt impossible—intelligent machines operating in dynamic jobsites—into reality.
  
  
Our connected ecosystem brings together massive volumes [BH1.1][LR1.2]of high-quality data to create a foundation where engineers like you can build and deploy against.
  
  
If this work motivates you, we invite you to join our team. In these roles, you’ll work at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. You’ll help design and deliver intelligent systems that enable machines to perceive their environment, make informed decisions, and support safer, more productive operations.
  
  
Apply today to build the new era of construction autonomy at Caterpillar.
  
  
**Posting Dates**
October 13, 2026 - October 26, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
  
  
Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

title: Senior NPU Compiler Engineer
description:
Role:
**Senior NPU Compiler Engineer**

Years:
**7-10 years | Chennai**

**Build the compiler that brings Processing-in-Memory AI to life.**

InCommon is hiring on behalf of a California based company that is building ultra-low-power neural processing technology for edge AI — chips that run advanced AI workloads within tight power and memory budgets. The Processing-in-Memory (PIM) architecture computes directly inside memory, breaking the traditional bottleneck of shuttling data back and forth.

We're looking for a
**Senior NPU Compiler Engineer**
to build the compiler stack — largely from the ground up — that takes models from TFLite, ONNX, and PyTorch and turns them into instructions our NPU can execute.

**What you'll do:**

🔹 Design and build the full compilation pipeline — graph import, operator lowering, scheduling, memory planning, and instruction generation

🔹 Map neural network graphs onto a novel dataflow / Processing-in-Memory architecture

🔹 Optimize for execution efficiency, memory bandwidth, and power

🔹 Build validation tools to compare compiler output against simulator and RTL results

🔹 Work directly with architecture, RTL, firmware, and ML teams to shape the hardware/software interface

**What you bring:**

✅ Strong experience building compilers, graph compilers, or backend toolchains

✅ Solid C++ and Python

✅ Deep understanding of compiler fundamentals — IRs, graph transforms, lowering, scheduling, codegen

✅ Experience with ML model formats (ONNX, TFLite, PyTorch) and neural network operators/tensors

✅ Background building software for NPUs, DSPs, GPUs, or other specialized accelerators

**Nice to have:**

⭐ Experience with MLIR, LLVM, TVM, XLA, Glow, or IREE

⭐ Familiarity with dataflow or Processing-in-Memory architectures

⭐ Experience with binary instruction streams, DMA engines, or on-chip SRAM

**Why join us:**

This is a rare chance to build a compiler stack from scratch for genuinely novel silicon — with real architectural influence, not just downstream implementation work. You'll shape decisions that affect the hardware itself, not just work around it.

Caterpillar’s Autonomy and Automation Group is building the autonomous planning platform that moves machines and manipulates terrain across construction sites.
  
  
As a Path Planning Engineer, you will design the navigation and terrain planning that lets autonomous machines drive, dig, and dump safely and efficiently — from stationary digging to high-speed machine navigation. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with experience in developing path planning algorithms, perception techniques and implementing production quality software in C++.

* Design terrain planning that decides where machines engage terrain — dig, dump, and push

* Create reusable planning libraries and common data objects such as path geometry and zones
* Develop search and optimization algorithms and motion & terrain interaction prediction models
* Develop production quality code and own your algorithms from design to production
* Run simulation for path planning algorithm development and test various scenarios

description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Data Discovery and Enrichment Expert II**
**Do you enjoy being part of a global team that works with a diverse range of products and technology?**
**Do you enjoy mentoring other engineers, and helping them grow their careers?**
**About Our Team**
Knowledge Innovation & Taxonomy Engineering (KITE) is the team within Elsevier Operations responsible for the taxonomies, vocabularies and knowledge graphs that sit beneath many of Elsevier’s products. In plain terms, a taxonomy is a structured, standardized, vocabulary of concepts, - such as diseases, drugs, materials or research topics — and the relationships between them. This shared structure is what lets our products tag content consistently, return relevant search results, connect related information, and feed reliable, well-grounded answers to AI features.
  
  
Main areas of work
  
  

* Taxonomy automation development — pipelines, scripts and tools that speed up taxonomy creation and editorial work.
* Platform development and support for CENtree, the shared taxonomy-management system used across all teams.
* Automated Curation and enrichment of taxonomies with semantic structure and relationships and their operationalization as reusable services.

**About The Role**
We are looking for an individual to support our team in linking our existing taxonomies and ontologies in a meaningful way, applying linked data standards and best practices. The ideal candidate combines strong technical skills in semantic web technologies with a solid understanding of data modelling for knowledge organization systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement methods for linking and aligning existing taxonomies and ontologies
* Model and maintain controlled vocabularies, taxonomies and ontologies using SKOS, SKOS-XL, and OWL
* Query and manipulate semantic data using SPARQL
* Integrate taxonomy/ontology data with other systems via REST APIs
* Write and maintain Python scripts/tools to support data modeling and integration workflows
* Collaborate with the team to understand data needs and translate them into semantic data models

**Requirements**

* Extensive hands-on experience with SPARQL
* Advanced Python programming skills
* Experience working with REST APIs
* Good data modelling experience
* Experience with at least one taxonomy/ontology management tool (e.g., Centre, Synaptica, Top Braid, Protégé, or equivalent)
* Understanding of linked data standards and principles
* Familiarity with semantic web standards (RDF, RDFS, JSON-LD)
* Ability to understand and translate business/data needs into semantic modeling solutions

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience linking or aligning multiple taxonomies/ontologies at scale
* Experience using Git/GitHub
* Understanding of AWS (specifically Batch, Lambda, Athena, S3, ECR, RDS, SNS/SQS)
* Hands-on knowledge of automation, CI/CD a plus
* Background in Life Sciences or similar
* Experience with SHACL

**Work in a way that works for you: -**
We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. With an average length of service of 9 years, we are confident that we offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, family leave and tuition reimbursement, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and long-term goals.
  
  
Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.
  
  
**Working for you: -**
**Benefits**
At Elsevier, we know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
  
  

* Group Health Insurance Policy (covering self and family)
* Group Life insurance/accident policy
* Generous long-service awards
* New Baby gift
* Subsidized food provided (applies to India- Chennai)
* Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, Gazetted Public Holiday and Maternity/Paternity Leave
* Free Transport provided to and from the office (applies to India-Chennai)

**About Us:**
-
  
  
A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice.  KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. **Customer Success \& Enablement**

* Train client admins and super\-users; develop enablement plans and adoption campaigns.

* Collaborate with Sales/Pre\-Sales for deal strategy, estimates, and RFP responses.
* Work with Data Engineering and Integration teams to ensure robust pipelines and API/connector reliability.


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
**Technical**
* Strong understanding of AI/ML foundations: NLP, LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, model evaluation.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks).
* Knowledge of data pipelines (ETL/ELT), vector databases/embeddings, and observability of AI systems.
* Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and responsible AI (RBAC, PII handling, auditability, human\-in\-the\-loop).
* Ability to create architecture diagrams, deployment runbooks, and performance monitoring strategies.


**Client\-Facing**
* Exceptional communication—can simplify complex AI concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Consultative approach—discovery, problem framing, value story, and objection handling.
* Strong demo presence; comfortable tailoring demos to industry verticals and role personas.
* Negotiation and stakeholder management across business, IT, InfoSec, and procurement.


**Mindset**
* Outcome\-oriented: focuses on measurable business impact, not just features.
* Curious and experimental: rapid prototyping, A/B testing, iterative improvement.
* Ownership and accountability: proactive risk management, transparent communication.


**Qualifications**
* 6–10\+ years in Client\-Facing Technical roles (e.g., Solutions Architect, Pre\-Sales Engineer, AI Consultant).
* 3\+ years hands\-on with AI/ML, LLM applications, or automation platforms.
* Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Experience in at least one enterprise vertical (e.g., BFSI, Manufacturing, Retail, Healthcare) is a plus.
* Certifications in cloud/AI (Azure AI Engineer, AWS ML Specialty, GCP ML Engineer) preferred.


**Typical WorkNEXT AI Use\-Case Areas (Adjust to your modules)**
* Knowledge assistant with RAG for policy/SOP retrieval, multilingual Q\&A.
* Process automation: ticket triage, claim summarization, email drafting, task routing.
* Insight generation: summarization of meetings/chats, trend analysis, risk alerts.
* Employee experience: HR policy assistant, IT helpdesk copilot, onboarding flows.
* Compliance \& governance: redaction, PII detection, audit\-ready conversation logs.


**Tools \& Tech Stack (Illustrative)**
* Cloud \& Infra: Azure (OpenAI, Cognitive Search), AWS (Bedrock, Sagemaker), GCP (Vertex AI).
* Data: Databricks/Snowflake/BigQuery; ETL tools (ADF, Airflow), vector stores (Pinecone, FAISS).
* Integration: REST/GraphQL APIs, iPaaS (MuleSoft, Boomi), event buses (Kafka).
* Observability \& Evaluation: Prometheus/Grafana, MLflow, human eval tooling, prompt/version management.

title: Transformation Lead - AD
description:
**Role:** 
 Transformation Lead
   

  

**Business Vertical:** 
 IOA – Tech
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Hands\-on leader who acts as one of our most senior technical experts in the field. This is a unique, dual\-mission role. Externally, you will engage with our most strategic clients in a "forward\-deployed" capacity, leading technical workshops to design and integrate our data solutions into their complex ecosystems. Internally, you will use these client insights to architect and build the next generation of AI\-powered tools and workflows, radically optimizing our own data annotation processes. Your ultimate goal is to create an unbeatable competitive advantage by continuously improving our efficiency, quality, and delivery, directly reducing our clients' Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Client Solution Engineering \& Integration (External Focus)**
* Lead Technical Discovery \& Solution Design: Post\-sale, partner with the Solutioning team to lead deep\-dive technical workshops with clients. Deconstruct their current workflows, data challenges, and business objectives.
* Architect Custom Integration Plans: Design and map out how our platform and services will integrate seamlessly into the client's existing AI/ML pipelines and infrastructure.
* Act as the "Art of the Possible" Guide: Serve as the primary technical advisor to clients, demonstrating how our advanced capabilities, custom tools, and innovative workflows can solve their most difficult data challenges and accelerate their AI initiatives.
* Bridge to the Platform Team: Translate complex client requirements into precise technical specifications and user stories for our core Platform Deployment \& Management team, ensuring our platform roadmap is directly informed by real\-world client needs.
* Oversee Proofs of Concept (POCs): Lead and develop targeted POCs to prove the value and viability of our solutions within the client's environment, de\-risking large\-scale engagements.


**Internal Process Transformation \& Innovation (Internal Focus)**
* Drive Process Excellence: Be the owner of operational efficiency for our data annotation workforce. Continuously analyze our Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) workflows to identify and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Develop AI\-Powered "Co\-Pilots" and Accelerators: Architect, build, and deploy a portfolio of internal tools and intelligent agents that augment our human annotators. This includes automated quality checks, predictive assistance, and workflow\-agnostic automation scripts.
* Engineer "Safety Nets": Design and implement automated quality assurance (QA) systems and predictive monitoring to ensure we consistently exceed client SLAs for accuracy and throughput.
* Champion Human\-in\-the\-Loop Optimization: Leverage Generative AI, LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), and computer vision models to create systems that make our human workforce smarter, faster, and more accurate.
* Quantify Business Impact: Develop and maintain a framework to measure the ROI of your transformation initiatives, clearly demonstrating their impact on project margins, delivery speed, and client TCO.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* Experience: 14\+ years in a technology field, with at least 5 years in a senior, client\-facing technical role such as a Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, Professional Services Consultant, or Transformation Lead.
* Applied AI \& Process Automation: Proven, hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-grade AI/ML systems specifically for process automation and optimization. This is more important than pure research experience.
* Generative AI Stack Expertise: Deep, practical experience with the modern Generative AI stack, including LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), agentic frameworks, and vector databases. You must have built things with these technologies.
* Hybrid Skillset: A demonstrated ability to operate at the intersection of deep technology and business strategy. You must be able to write code and architect systems, but also create a compelling business case and present to a client executive.
* Cloud Architecture: Deep architectural expertise in one or more major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including their managed AI/ML services (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Consultative Mindset: A natural ability to listen, diagnose problems, and guide clients and internal teams toward elegant, effective solutions.
* Data Annotation Domain Knowledge: Direct experience with data annotation platforms, data quality challenges, and the operational dynamics of large\-scale data labeling workforces.
* Experience Building Internal Tools: A track record of identifying an internal business need and building a software solution to address it, driving measurable efficiency gains.
* An advanced degree (master's or PhD) in Computer Science, AI, or a related field is a strong plus.
* A portfolio of projects (e.g., GitHub) or detailed case studies demonstrating your work in building AI\-driven solutions.

title: Principal Engineer, AI Platform Software Architecture
description:

**Job Area**

**General Summary**
 At Qualcomm, you will join a global leader in semiconductor technology and help shape the future of AI at the edge. You will work alongside world\-class engineers, architects, and product leaders to define the software architecture that enables AI experiences across a diverse range of products, including wearables, smartphones, XR devices, automotive platforms, edge computing systems, and AI PCs.
   

  

 The Core Platform Software Architecture team is seeking an experienced and highly influential Principal Engineer, AI Platform Software Architecture to drive the software and system architecture for next\-generation AI inferencing platforms. In this role, you will lead cross\-functional architectural initiatives spanning software, hardware, security, memory systems, and AI accelerators while helping shape the long\-term technology strategy for Qualcomm's AI platform roadmap.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 8\+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

 Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 7\+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.

 PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 6\+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.
   

  

* 4\+ years of work experience with Programming Language such as C, C\+\+, Java, Python, etc.


 The successful candidate will serve as a technical leader responsible for influencing software and silicon architecture decisions across multiple product lines and future generations of AI platforms.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Define and drive the long\-term platform software architecture and technical strategy for AI inferencing across Qualcomm's portfolio of edge AI products, influencing technology investments and architectural decisions across multiple product generations.

* Drive alignment across organizations through architecture reviews, technical leadership, and effective stakeholder engagement.
* Mentor and influence engineers and architects across the company while helping establish architectural best practices, technical standards, and long\-term technology direction.

* SoC and computer architecture

title: Spec-Business Intelligence
description:
When you join Verizon
   

  

 You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing...**
 At Verizon, we aren't just building a world\-class Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) organization—we are fundamentally redefining the future of finance. As we step into the AI era, we are pioneering intelligent, AI\-driven FP\&A practices that will completely transform how finance teams operate and deliver strategic value. Through a comprehensive initiative to streamline processes, modernize our systems, and invest heavily in the continuous growth of our people, we are setting the industry standard. This is your opportunity to be the catalyst for this AI\-powered revolution, helping us make Verizon the ultimate destination for forward\-thinking FP\&A professionals.
   

  

 Move Beyond Compiling Data And Help Tell The Story Behind The Numbers. The Corporate FP\&A Positions Offer Opportunities To Drive Better Business Partnering And Insights While Developing Your Skill Set And Leadership As We Continue To Grow As a World\-class Organization. You Are a Valuable Business Partner, Finding New And Better Ways Of Working By Leveraging Digital And AI Capabilities. You’ll Become Involved In Planning, Reporting, Analyses, And Initiatives That Will Impact Important Decisions Around The Growth And Development Of Verizon's Business. In Our Department, You Will
   

  

* Architect Intelligent Workflows: Identify bottlenecks in traditional FP\&A processes (like month\-end close or manual data consolidation) and spearhead the implementation of automations and AI solutions.
* AI\-Enhanced Data Storytelling: Transform complex, multi\-layered datasets into clear, actionable intelligence using advanced data visualization tools and AI\-generated insights.
* Bridge Finance and Technology: Act as the crucial link between traditional FP\&A and data science teams, ensuring AI algorithms are trained with deep financial context and commercial acumen
* Prompt Engineering for Finance: Utilize generative AI tools to rapidly synthesize financial data, draft preliminary variance narratives, and accelerate the reporting cycle.
* Ensure timely and accurate delivery of financial planning, reporting \& analyses for the business.
* Be a trusted advisor by providing valuable decision support and guidance to FP\&A Business Partners.
* Proactive Value Creation: Move beyond retrospective reporting to become a forward\-looking strategic advisor, using AI\-driven scenario planning to guide executive decision\-making and identify growth opportunities.
* Actively participate in the cultural and professional development of Corporate FP\&A as a world\-class organization through Mentor/Mentee relationships and various activities offered.
* Be the Impetus for Change: Champion the adoption of AI and modern finance practices across the broader Verizon team, overcoming resistance to change through education and proven results.


 As part of the Corporate FP\&A team, you will be helping the reporting and accounting teams deliver world\-class, zero\-touch automated solutions for all Verizon entities. You will interact with finance teams across the business, bringing new automated and AI\-driven solutions to life for our month\-end financial close and reporting activities.
   

  

**Reporting, Automation \& Data Visualization**
* Deliver best\-in\-class end\-to\-end automated solutions for our stakeholders to support Finance Business Units (BUs) and drive efficiencies.
* Design data visualizations of financial statements for different organizations across Verizon.
* Deliver C\-Suite Executive reporting with 100% quality and accuracy.
* Collaborate with the various stakeholders to deploy Qlik/ Looker Applications in production environments and resolve any production issues with existing applications.
* Document processes to ensure accuracy across the enterprise and maintain strict change control.


**AI \& Analytics Systems Architecture**
* Design and build AI solutions that interact with development tools, codebases, and team workflows in meaningful ways.
* Work extensively with LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini, Codex, and others) to understand their capabilities, limitations, and optimal application patterns for financial automation.
* Own the developer experience of agentic interactions—making complex AI capabilities feel natural and trustworthy for finance end\-users.
* Lead technical decision\-making on agent patterns, model selection, and integration approaches.


 What we’re looking for…
   

  

 You are a strong collaborator who can effectively own and prioritize multiple work streams and adapt during pressured situations. You display initiative and resourcefulness but are also comfortable brainstorming and sharing ideas in a team environment. You possess excellent communication skills and can partner effectively across multiple business and finance teams to speak to both internal and external stakeholders. You are adaptable to change, meet tight deadlines, and are strongly focused on the quality of your deliverables.
   

  

**You'll Need To Have**
* Bachelor’s degree and Four or more years of work experience in financial report automations.
* Five or more years of relevant work experience in Business Intelligence/Analytics within FP\&A teams (but not limited to this function).
* Hands on experience in Qlik Sense \& Tableau.
* Experience with Looker, LookML will be an added advantage
* Vizlib and NPrinting experience in Qlik Sense.
* Deep, hands\-on experience building AI agents or agentic systems in production.
* Strong understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations across multiple models (Claude, Gemini, Codex, etc.).
* Expertise in prompt engineering, model selection, and working with tool\-use/function calling.
* Ability to mine, extract, transform, and load large financial datasets to create zero\-touch reports.
* Working knowledge of report automation tools, technologies, and end\-to\-end ETL processes (e.g., Knime Analytics Platform, Alteryx).
* Experience with Qlik Sense and QVD generations from different data sources.
